epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豔麗女模余虹敏在一間盛傳鬧鬼的廢棄醫院中離奇身亡。事後,她生前的攝影師不斷接到如怨靈索命般的詭異來電,合作撰稿人突遭嚴重車禍,而她的摯友亦突然離奇失蹤。一連串毛骨悚然的怪事接踵而來,彷彿死者充滿妒恨的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家為了挽救低迷的事業,決心創作一部暢銷小說。他重返童年故居,這裡亦是其身為知名作家的父親當年神秘身亡之地。當他意外發現父親留下的最後手稿時,才驚覺這部作品遠超自己的才華。於是,他決定將..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
民國年間,江南村落接連發生離奇命案,逐漸淪為遠近聞名的鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與員警萬楓為追查一宗滅門慘案,深入陰森村莊抽絲剝繭,
誓要揭開連環命案背後的真相,破除流傳已久的封建迷信。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Republican era, a Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes the infamous ghost village of Fengmen. Journalist Li Mu and police officer Wan Feng venture into the eerie village to uncover the truth behind the killings and shatter the grip of superstition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 建築師May與男友Gun搬入新居後,驟聞繼母離奇身亡。May收留孤苦的繼妹Noon,怎料她入宅後竟行為詭異,頻遭惡靈附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象與嚴重失眠的折磨。隨著宅內黑暗秘密逐步揭開,通靈法師終於..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
民國年間,江南村落接連發生離奇命案,逐漸淪為遠近聞名的鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與員警萬楓為追查一宗滅門慘案,深入陰森村莊抽絲剝繭,
誓要揭開連環命案背後的真相,破除流傳已久的封建迷信。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天淩晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their fathers death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their fathers death which now threatens them both.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤獨內向的阿振在工作中飽受同事殘酷欺淩,絕望中他試圖透過網路尋找理想伴侶來救贖心靈。當一位與他夢中情人如出一轍的神秘女子米娜出現後,阿振以為迎來了真愛,不料一連串驚悚詭異的怪事卻接連發生,將他拖入無底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bullied by his coworkers, the lonely Ah Zhen turns to the internet in search of his ideal girl. However, when Mina, the woman of his dreams, suddenly enters his life, a series of unexpected events begins to unfold.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深主播艾米遭遇詭異蝙蝠襲擊後,帶著傷口返回電台,準備主持當晚的深夜節目。豈料竟遭無良老闆設局解僱,並被新人強行取代。適逢暴風雨封鎖整座電台,隨著傷口引發的異變愈演愈烈,艾米逐漸失控,在直播間掀起一場..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Radio host Amy is bitten by a mysterious bat, but she returns to the station to host that night’s late-night show. Instead, she is set up and fired by her ruthless boss, then replaced by a newcomer. As a violent storm traps everyone in the station and her mysterious wound worsens, Amy gradually loses control and unleashes a bloody massacre.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深主播艾米遭遇詭異蝙蝠襲擊後,帶著傷口返回電台,準備主持當晚的深夜節目。豈料竟遭無良老闆設局解僱,並被新人強行取代。適逢暴風雨封鎖整座電台,隨著傷口引發的異變愈演愈烈,艾米逐漸失控,在直播間掀起一場..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Radio host Amy is bitten by a mysterious bat, but she returns to the station to host that night’s late-night show. Instead, she is set up and fired by her ruthless boss, then replaced by a newcomer. As a violent storm traps everyone in the station and her mysterious wound worsens, Amy gradually loses control and unleashes a bloody massacre.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

epg.programme_title_tc: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美國加州Ojai鎮流傳著一處神秘的「惡魔漩渦」,據說凡是踏入其禁地的人,都將被黑暗力量吞噬。六段彼此交織的恐怖故事,逐步揭開這股邪惡力量的真相,以及一棟遭受詛咒的房屋與歷代住戶無法逃離的駭人命運。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ojai, California, a mysterious spiritual vortex is said to unleash dark forces upon anyone who enters its domain. Through six interconnected horror tales, the terrifying secrets of a cursed house and its doomed inhabitants are revealed, exposing the sinister power lurking behind the Devils Vortex.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬來西亞一座與世隔絕的高原高科技療養院內,Jeghan博士秘密利用三名窮凶極惡的連環殺手進行人體生化改造實驗。豈料實驗失控,三人變異成毫無痛覺、殺戮本能全面覺醒的怪物,血洗實驗室後逃入叢林,恐怖殺戮自..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At a secluded high-tech asylum hidden in the Malaysian highlands, Dr Jeghan secretly conducts biogenetic experiments on three notorious serial killers. When the experiment goes horribly wrong, the mutated killers escape into the jungle as ruthless, pain-free predators, unleashing an unstoppable wave of terror and bloodshed.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a boy, Xie Yi Zhong performed a spirit-summoning ritual and accidentally invoked Bai Wu Chang, the White Reaper, triggering a tragedy. Years later, he returns home to find his hometown plagued by eerie events and his loved ones lives at stake. Will he dare summon the spirit again to confront the evil forces?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 菲律賓警方調查一宗極其殘忍、涉及邪教祭祀的離奇連環屠殺案時,在薄荷島救出唯一的倖存者,而她竟是一名隱姓埋名的前美國FBI探員。隨著調查不斷深入,她供述的遠古預言、惡魔附身與血腥祭祀,逐漸將所有人捲入一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While investigating a series of cult ritual massacres, Philippine police rescue the sole survivor on Bohol Island, who is a former FBI agent living under a false identity. As the investigation deepens, her accounts of ancient prophecies, demonic possession and bloody rituals draw everyone into a terrifying mystery where reality blurs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 謝毅忠年少時跳童請神,請來的竟是大伯爺白無常,釀成一場無法挽回的悲劇,自此再也不敢請神。多年後重返故鄉,村中詭異怪事接連發生,至親性命危在旦夕。面對邪靈作祟,他能否再次請神出煞,化解這場生死劫難?

epg.programme_title_tc: 忍者龜之都市傳奇 [英/普]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 忍者龜跟變種動物被世紀暴風雨困住了!但是一群新來的海洋變種生物對紐約造成威脅...拉斐爾被迫要開口拯救這個城市.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當重裝雇傭兵圍攻白宮,一名面試特勤局失敗的特警必須衝破封鎖線,奮力營救總統、拯救被扣為人質的女兒,並阻止第三次世界大戰爆發。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When heavily armed mercenaries siege the White House, a rejected Secret Service applicant must fight through the lockdown to save the President, rescue his hostage daughter, and prevent World War III.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當妻子在結婚紀念日當天神秘失蹤,丈夫成了頭號嫌疑人。隨著媒體鋪天蓋地的瘋狂報導,各種毒辣的秘密陸續曝光, reveal 他們完美的婚姻不過是一場致命的錯覺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When his wife mysteriously vanishes on their anniversary, a man becomes the prime suspect. As the media circus explodes, toxic secrets reveal their perfect marriage is a deadly illusion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當暴徒襲擊前刺客約翰·維克(基努·李維 飾)時,他們完全不知道自己招惹了一位黑道傳奇。維克將紐約市變成彈痕累累的戰場,展開一場毫不留情的追殺與復仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When thugs attack ex-assassin John Wick (Keanu Reeves), they have no idea theyve unleashed an underworld legend. Turning NYC into a bullet-riddled playground, Wick embarks on a merciless rampage to hunt down his adversaries.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:自由幻夢 Ⅰ
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球轟動的系列持續延燒。凱妮絲(珍妮佛·勞倫斯 飾)在摧毀飢餓遊戲後倖存下來,並與第13區聯手,挺身對抗殘暴的史諾總統(唐納·蘇德蘭 飾)。革命的火焰已被點燃,帕納姆的命運正面臨最關鍵的一戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The worldwide phenomenon continues. Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) has survived and destroyed the Hunger Games, and now rises with District 13 to fight against President Snow (Donald Sutherland).

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Citizens fighting for independence from Britain were met by an Army-quelled bloody riot that the government covered up. Over 100 Maltese were falsely jailed for instigating the violence.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在充斥著貪腐、謀殺以及影星光環的繁華背後,三名警官誓死奮戰,只為揭開一起殘忍連環慘案背後的駭人真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amidst corruption, murder and the glamour of famous movie stars, three police officer fight to uncover the truth of a brutal mass murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Quentin Tarantino’s 8th film takes place in wintry Wyoming, where eight strangers, including two bounty hunters and a wanted fugitive, find themselves battling the elements and each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 改編自漫威漫畫角色,特技摩托車手強尼·布雷斯獻出靈魂成為地獄復仇者,迎戰魔王之子——野心勃勃的黑心魔。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on the Marvel Comics character, stunt motorcyclist Johnny Blaze gives up his soul to become a hell-blazing vigilante, to fight against power-hungry Blackheart, the son of the devil himself.

蒼茫的荒漠中,遠遠可見一名白袍男子、撐著一把細花紙傘、騎在驢背上、正隨手編寫著一本黃曆…

書攤老闆想當一天巴頓將軍;因為..

這日,一起飯館的民事糾紛被提到衙門評理,無非又是打架鬥毆損壞桌椅之類,可周正一..

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jackie Chan plays a dual role as twins separated at birth who grow up and cross paths. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: After the parents of Ruby (Leelee Sobieski) and her younger brother, Rhett (Trevor Morgan), are killed in a car crash, their parents' best friends, Erin and Terry Glass (Diane Lane, Stellan Skarsgard), become their guardians. The children hear promises of a world of opulence and California fun -- all they have to do is move into the Glasses' gated house. Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若結合武林兩大魔頭,插翅虎及活閻王,的武功,他們必定獨霸武林,江湖又將有一輪腥風血雨。活閻王為促成這個邪惡聯盟,決將胞妹嫁給插翅虎。究竟最後二人之毒計會否得逞?誰可挽救一場武林浩劫?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King’s sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末年,光緒帝親政后,開始着手維新變法,惜改革觸犯了想保全自身富貴功名的官僚的阻擾。支持皇帝變法的康有為性格軟弱,堅持變法的譚嗣同難免浮躁,光緒深知自己的處境危險,於是企圖利用袁世凱去對付握有兵權的榮祿。但在關鍵時刻,袁世凱見風使舵卻向榮祿告了密,出賣了光緒...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 總鏢頭李志山的妻子私通對頭人龍震天,並設計先偷飛龍刀,再殺害李志山及女兒小燕,幸好最後李氏父女成功逃脫。小燕長大後,更成為武功高強的女劍客,誓要為死去的母親報仇。直至一個偶然的機會,小燕遇到仍然在生的母親,才駭然發現真相,原來自己一直被父親的謊言所蒙騙。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Convoy Master Li’s wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li’s Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘭嶼紅蟲為患,島上人只信大頭目及巫醫巴達兩人。年青醫生何維德到蘭嶼找尋曾到此研究紅蟲而失蹤的父親,因而與未婚妻白丹娜鬧翻。後來何與孤女雅蘭相愛,惹來西呼達嫉妒;同時何為島民治病,令巴達信眾日減,西呼達、巴達均伺機殺何,何身陷險境而不自知……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清廷高手駱一虎殺害反清義士陳貴,陳妻偕女小薇逃往廣龍鎮。鎮上兩家武館勢成水火,何教頭之侄家玉生性調皮,因營救小薇識破了老師為反清首領的身份。隨著至親與恩師相繼喪命於駱一虎之手,原本好勝頑皮的家玉憤而承擔起復仇重任,與清廷勢力展開生死決戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master’s identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富家小姐梅淑卿與窮教師江少文,為了自由戀愛,脫離父母,從城市遷往小鎮結婚生活。他們生育五個兒女,但生存的擔子日重,二人長期辛勞,終相繼亡故。小兒女頓失庇蔭,直接面對複雜的社會,幾乎各散東西……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓九重為奪削鐵如泥的青霜劍,誘殺師弟談鶴鳴;談鶴鳴的妻子耿六娘隱姓埋名在將軍府為傭,伺機奪劍報仇。將軍女兒嬌龍拜六娘為師,練成一身武藝,並與六娘師侄羅翼虎相戀。翼虎順嬌龍之意,深夜到親王府盜劍,然而寡不敵眾,失手被擒;嬌龍率眾營救,與韓九重等人展開連場激戰。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 淩波的丈夫高遠及其友王俠,均與肚皮舞女郎孟莉有染,孟藉此勒索二人;後孟被殺,高成嫌疑犯,另孟之兄翟諾,亦向高勒索;而淩在家,也接見了穀峰,他聲言有為高洗罪的證據,但要索錢;王妻李香君借貸給淩... 究竟誰是殺孟真凶?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mrs Lins husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin’s

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩大珠寶盜賊「夜來香」和「夜爵士」前往日本,意圖偷去「維納斯的眼淚」巨鑽。二人見面後即墜入愛河,卻不知道原來對方同為盜取巨鑽的競敵。最後誰會得到巨鑽?二人的戀情又會否無疾而終?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus’ Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will g

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃太太獨力撫養兒子Alex成人,與媳婦阿彤一起生活。豈料Alex意外逝世,死前道出外遇女友黑仔已懷有身孕。結果三名沒有老公的女人同住一室...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃太太獨力撫養兒子Alex成人,與媳婦阿彤一起生活。豈料Alex意外逝世,死前道出外遇女友黑仔已懷有身孕。結果三名沒有老公的女人同住一室...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在河北省某貪汙成風的小縣內,流浪漢甄明與賈亮因掌握一眾縣官的貪汙和醜聞證據,得以順水推舟假扮縣長,把各官員玩弄於股掌之中,峰迴路轉,結局卻出人意表。全片除帶出人生如戲的黑色幽默,也狠狠地鞭撻為官者殘民以自肥的無恥行為。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩大武林劍客葉孤城與西門吹雪將於紫禁城決鬥。陸小鳳忖度二人素末謀面,又無利益衝突,無須決鬥,猜想當中一定事有蹊蹺。於是,他決定和花滿樓前往京城調查清楚,卻發現當中隱藏的陰謀…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 劇情講述,知縣之子劉子和,垂涎葛小大之妻小白菜,用迷藥將其姦污。劉子和事後恐東窗事發,用砒霜毒死葛小大。葛死後,鎮內流言四起,知縣為救愛兒,設計嫁禍小白菜婚前戀人楊乃武。乃武被苦打成招,其姊楊淑英不忍見弟含冤而死,到刑部要求翻案……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she’s soon framed for her husband’s murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 周鵬被神捕諸葛森追殺,投靠表兄包妥。林家大少奶被男鬼杜洛所殺,要求鵬二人帶其鬼魂上路,到開封找公孫先生消滅杜鬼魂。鵬以大少奶的鬼符在賭場贏取路費,更與戲子吳順超一同上路...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huan Zhus ghost seeks help from “Fake Ghost Catchers” Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitors ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they uni

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 杜孟飛奉命下山闖蕩江湖,途中救出遭黑道中人捉拿的沐婉兒,杜挺身相救,沐萬分感激。未幾,杜又救出被黑道中人圍攻的少女李賽男。及後,杜無意中得知一段二十年前的江湖恩怨,黑道首領是李之殺父仇人,而沐則是黑道首領失散的女兒…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鄧彪因為黑貨買賣失手,遂逼江湖人物高明供出從中陷害者,高明說出乃黑豹所為後,即被開槍殺死,鄧彪因此被判監禁十五年。他出獄後即找黑豹報仇,卻遇上勢力龐大的葛八爺幹擾;同時商琳為尋失蹤十五年的丈夫,欲找鄧彪查問黑豹下落,但兩人僅聽過黑豹其名,從未見其人,究竟黑豹是誰?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real ide

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 朱國棟和李明珠本打算結婚,無奈雙方父母為多年死對頭,所以堅決反對婚事。於是二人不惜假裝自殺。有見及此雙方家長最終冰釋前嫌,答應二人成婚。此時,唱片公司宣佈會為出棟的歌曲版,最終可謂雙喜臨門。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announ

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述,某寺青年僧人「瘋子」,性格瘋瘋癲癲,行為全不符僧人規範。該寺主持玄明方丈卻認為「瘋子」與佛有緣,並因應其性格與氣質,授以「癲羅漢拳」。「瘋子」有了武功後,動輒出拳傷人,方丈只得將其逐出寺門...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandits son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王昭君拒絕賄賂畫師,於是一直被畫師畫醜致未被皇帝看上。但皇帝初遇昭君後,驚為天人,即選中她。畫師被逐後,為報復而設計將昭君與匈奴可汗和親。皇帝因拒絕婚事即引來兩國爭戰,以致王昭君最後為了平息戰亂不得不犧牲自己。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun’s warlord as a rev

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 此片述說了關於林沖的故事。宋朝禁軍教頭林沖遭受貪官陷害,被放逐滄州,更陷入險境。幸得花和尚相助,林沖成功脫險,更展開復仇大計。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty’s Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「多咀街」是一條丁字形的熱鬧街道,住客大多是各行各業的小市民。他們對社會所發生的大小事情喜歡談論,七嘴八舌,招惹是非;三言兩語,道出人情冷暖,有道是:言為心聲。不管是粵劇藝員、暴發戶、黑社會人物或司機,他們說的話是嬉笑怒罵或冷嘲熱諷也好,都足以反映出現實社會人情百態之一斑。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. Howeve

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 平西王因與金龍山強盜結仇,女兒被擄走。他非常焦急,請劍俠岳震北幫忙,嶽估計一人之力不夠,幸得多位武功高強的好友相助一同去金龍山破盜寨。各人步步小心,希望能成功救人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Duke’s daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu m

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歌星白眉有一豪宅,與空姐朱黛、舞女姚姚同住,三女各有愛情際遇;白眉雖愛錢,卻傾情自稱從外地來的路俊,兩人只好互許後會有期之願;朱黛曾迷戀已婚飛機師,分手後又愛上賽車手;姚姚的最大心願是把清白之軀留給丈夫,她本最愛窮工人李吉,李吉卻因自卑而忍痛分手,姚姚嫁予富家子,卻仍掛念李吉...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清廷派人掃平少林寺,殺掉所有少林弟子。從中倖存出來的兩名弟子,分別拜入詠春及洪拳師傅門下,學習拳法。最終他們挾技擊敗敵人,並為死去師兄弟報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighter

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清廷派人掃平少林寺,殺掉所有少林弟子。從中倖存出來的兩名弟子,分別拜入詠春及洪拳師傅門下,學習拳法。最終他們挾技擊敗敵人,並為死去師兄弟報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighter

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武打明星劉家輝飾演反清組織成員,並逃難到少林寺求藝。為了報仇雪恨,他矢寺要在「天下武宗」少林學懂上乘的武學。他學成少林寺三十五房功夫後,創立少林寺第三十六房功夫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 導演張堅庭在本片體現香港八十年代的大城小景;陳友與妻子惠英紅從大陸來港投靠父親,卻發現他並非如信中所言生活富足。東方之珠的美夢換來悲喜交集。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as City Lights

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蜈蚣功的鹿峰、蛇功的韋白、蠍子功的孫建、壁虎功的郭追、蛤蟆功的羅莽,各擅勝場,不同型格。電影風格奇特,一開始五毒門清理門戶,派出楊得將五個高手就地正法。同出師門,卻受師父追殺,有人說是喻他一手建立的張家班命运,張徹拍出殺戮的悲劇,沒有他慣常的大義浩然,卻有天地不容的毀滅性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八歲的玫瑰在澳門結識了富家子家聰。太平洋戰爭爆發,兩人被迫分手。七年後,玫瑰得知家聰結婚,傷心痛哭。玫瑰婚後,丈夫去世,開了一間花店,一天,小女孩來買花,才知小女孩是自己女兒,更與家聰重遇...文藝導演秦劍的愛情悲喜劇,保持作深情,感人之水準。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Not a love triangle but a love rectangle, Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓九重為奪削鐵如泥的青霜劍,誘殺師弟談鶴鳴;談鶴鳴的妻子耿六娘隱姓埋名在將軍府為傭,伺機奪劍報仇。將軍女兒嬌龍拜六娘為師,練成一身武藝,並與六娘師侄羅翼虎相戀。翼虎順嬌龍之意,深夜到親王府盜劍,然而寡不敵眾,失手被擒;嬌龍率眾營救,與韓九重等人展開連場激戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased masters sword called the Green Frost Sword. Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going un

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貧寒書生張珍投奔相府,卻遭嫌貧愛富的準岳父冷落。碧波潭鯉魚精同情他的遭遇,化身相國千金,深夜與張珍相會,兩人漸生情愫。此事引發「真假千金」鬧相府的風波,更招來張天師降妖圍剿。面對天兵天將,張珍誓死不離,最終感動觀音,令鯉魚精化為凡人,與張珍終成眷屬。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellor’s family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellor’s daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daught

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 赤膽忠心的楊家將,世世代代為國而戰,子子孫孫為民而死,直戰到最後一員虎將楊宗保,不幸在金山之役中了埋伏,全營將士壯烈犧牲。楊宗保身負箭傷,被困金山,以身殉國。楊家滿門為保衛宋朝江山及替楊宗保報仇,在老祖母佘老太君的發起下,組成了一支楊家軍,誓與番邦周旋到底!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 船員孫志强巧合成爲「火花大樂隊」的鼓手,他因急于成名,答應幫助音樂雜志出版人李源明接近樂隊經理黃麗真,以換取源明的力捧。終于,志强得償所願,一炮而紅,源明却逼他實踐諾言,與麗真斷絕來往。志强受到極大打擊,唯有忍痛離開樂隊與麗真...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the groups drummer/leader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummers

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編。故事講述唐僧赴西天取經,中途在五指山收服馬騮精;在高家莊收服豬八戒;在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節。。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang’s journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年醫生時振聲在醫院中發現很多奇難雜症,無法以醫學理論解釋,遂請好友齊中平夫婦共同研究。幾經追查,才發現那些病人均是中了降頭。原來施降者是精通邪術,以「愛情降頭」協助富商追求夢中情人,博取巨額報酬。中平不信妖邪之說,其妻子更不惜以身相試,更被施以「死降」,如果無法破解,二十四小時後便會身亡…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing’s wife and casts an evil love spell on

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小寶陰差陽錯地闖入宮廷,意外成為康熙皇帝的好友。此時,他又受到天地會的命令,必須竊取極為重要的四十二章經,而康熙皇帝本人也在追查其下落。聰明的小寶在兩方敵對勢力之間周旋,最終憑藉聰明才智成功脫險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wei Xiao Bao inadvertently enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi, whilst covertly serving rebels seeking the sacred “Sutra of Forty-Two Chapters”. Caught between rival factions when the Emperor seeks it too, Xiao Bao must rely

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漢朝末年太師董卓霸道專橫,弄權禍國,忠臣王允誓要利用貂蟬的美色設計除掉董卓。王允得知董卓的義子呂布見貂蟬貌若天仙一見鍾情,於是將計就計把貂蟬獻給董卓為妾,終使父子反目。呂布最後殺了父親董卓,自此與貂蟬成為眷屬。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn’s beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong’s concubine as he knows Dong’s adopted son Lu Bu is in love w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《五毒天羅》是武林至毒之物,不知收藏何方。五毒教的蛇壇主,要找出天羅所在,獨霸武林,誤放消息,謂天羅已重現武林,江湖一片風聲鶴唳…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan’s disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score “The Proud One”. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan’s leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花花公子周國雄有一本「獵人日記」專門去記錄他四出獵艷的故事,周丟棄劉明華,又去追獵呂綺美,劉突然遭人殺死。後來周又去追求女學生朱麗珍…但當晚,呂遭殺死,警方向周追查。同時周想到和他親近的女人,一個一個的被殺死,嫌兇漸指向他,好像有人在陷害自己。周開始追查真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murd

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九王爺謀朝篡位,率領奸臣叛賊攻入皇宮;皇帝見大勢已去,命兩名忠心侍衛各抱一名太子突圍而出。輾轉之下,大太子由少林戒律院三僧撫養,法號道行,習得少林絕技;二太子則易名五子泰,由丞相撫養。多年後,五子泰前往少林寺借閱「易筋經」,與道行相遇,卻不知對方正是親兄弟……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must c

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歐陽鋒得悉郭靖以九陰真經的功夫於選婿比武中獲勝,並娶得黃蓉為妻,於是把黃蓉挾走,要脅郭靖要默寫九陰真經才會釋放黃蓉。最終郭靖會否為救出黃蓉而就範?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong’s hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洛陽無敵莊莊主失去了所有功力,於是請來侄兒與未婚妻一起護送黃金前往京城。在途中,他們遇到了一名神秘俠客,三人隨即聯手對抗盜匪,竭力保護黃金不被劫走。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancée to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 軍閥割據時代,江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的傳統騙術層出不窮,「蛇神」、「李三腳」、「三隻手」等一群妖言惑眾的騙徒令人云亦云的愚民上釣,反映舊時代一切牛鬼蛇神眾生相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 郭靖回到中原時,遇上黃蓉,二人一見鍾情雙雙墮入愛河。豈料,同時間歐陽克竟又向黃蓉提親。於是黃藥師決定以比武選婿,對決的勝方可娶女兒黃蓉為妻。經過一輪激戰,郭靖最後成功打敗歐陽克,奪得美人歸。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang’s father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally bea

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝時代,書生田玉川因替漁夫伸張正義,誤殺總督之子,被迫逃亡。走投無路時,他逃至江畔,幸得漁夫之女相救。二人在險境中情愫暗生,玉川遂以傳家至寶「蝴蝶盃」為信物,締結終身之約。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman’s honour but accidentally kills the governor’s son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river’s edge, he is rescued by the fisherman’s daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片由三個單元故事組成,為岳楓、程剛及張徹聯合執導,當年就有「花一張票價,看三套電影」的稱譽。嶽楓之〈鐵弓緣〉講述一對青年男女因一把鐵弓而結緣、程剛之〈胭脂虎〉講述一群絕色妓女的故事、張徹之〈白水灘〉講述梁山英雄後代的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 方明在趕路途中邂逅神秘年輕女子冷秋屏,兩人情投意合並私訂終身。婚後方明驚覺妻子竟是受邪靈操控、被迫吸取男子精氣的亡魂,但冷秋屏因真情不忍加害。最終在道士相助下,方明擊敗邪靈救出愛妻,然而人鬼殊途,兩人於晨光中淒然訣別,冷秋屏含淚投胎轉世。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men’s life essence. With a Taoist’s help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鄧彪因為黑貨買賣失手,遂逼江湖人物高明供出從中陷害者,高明說出乃黑豹所為後,即被開槍殺死,鄧彪因此被判監禁十五年。他出獄後即找黑豹報仇,卻遇上勢力龐大的葛八爺幹擾;同時商琳為尋失蹤十五年的丈夫,欲找鄧彪查問黑豹下落,但兩人僅聽過黑豹其名,從未見其人,究竟黑豹是誰?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real ide

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述飾花花公子的喬莊與好友楊帆,同時愛上胡燕妮,但楊成人之美。但喬因生殖力弱,故當胡懷孕時,就懷疑妻與楊有染…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. Davids sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明皇身染惡疾,駕崩在即,卻無子可繼帝位;皇侄世子傑本可繼位,惜不成器,難當大任。皇弟徽王想起明皇曾與東宮宮女生有子女各一,現時藏匿于東陽縣,遂命锦衣衛劉玄平尋找公主與王子的下落。劉玄平路上屢遭世子傑爪牙追殺,幸得俠士來如風相助...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperors nephew hires assassins to kill the c

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 劇情講述,知縣之子劉子和,垂涎葛小大之妻小白菜,用迷藥將其姦污。劉子和事後恐東窗事發,用砒霜毒死葛小大。葛死後,鎮內流言四起,知縣為救愛兒,設計嫁禍小白菜婚前戀人楊乃武。乃武被苦打成招,其姊楊淑英不忍見弟含冤而死,到刑部要求翻案……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she’s soon framed for her husband’s murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Teenagers stumble across a prehistoric caveman, who goes on a rampage.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Teenagers stumble across a prehistoric caveman, who goes on a rampage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: John Thornton, is a fearless man who's after more than gold; he wants to do what's right. Thornton works for the U.S. mail and is the only person daring and smart enough to figure out how to travel the deadly 600 miles from Skagway to Dawson, Alaska in the icy winter. His incredibly dog Buck is by his side and part of how he survives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A scientist keeps his wife young by killing, stealing the bodies of, and taking the gland fluid from virgin brides.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A scientist keeps his wife young by killing, stealing the bodies of, and taking the gland fluid from virgin brides.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: George Trent, a British spy, has gone incommunicado in Ibiza. Appleton Porter (Donald Sutherland) is sent to find out what happened to Trent. Porter settles into a small hotel with several busybody guests. He probes them for information about Trent, their former neighbor. Meanwhile, the spy survives several attempts on his life as he attempts to solve the mystery.

Meanwhile, the spy survives several attempts on his life as he attempts to solve the mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Han Wu-song, an antique collector, gets killed while appraising a bronze horse rider statue which trader Wang Dae-in has stolen from a tomb. Dae-in dies on the scene and Wu-song leaves the killer's name on the cave wall before he dies. Dae-in's son Wang Gak thinks Wu-Song killed his father and fights with his son Jung-pa. Trader Kwan and her daughter Mi-ryung stop the fight. Jung-pa and Mi-ryung's love is disturbed by Ju-yang. Gak and Jung-pa chase him to find Wu-song's body with Ju-yang's name on the wall but Mi-ryung appeals them not to kill...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Deep in the desert, a rural American family is forced to endure a night of inter-dimensional, extra terrestrial terror when a UFO appears over their home.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deep in the desert, a rural American family is forced to endure a night of inter-dimensional, extra terrestrial terror when a UFO appears over their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: After witnessing a man's death in a bizarre accident, Father Pergado goes on a spiritual retreat, where he encounters his alien double bent on world conquest.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After witnessing a man's death in a bizarre accident, Father Pergado goes on a spiritual retreat, where he encounters his alien double bent on world conquest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A scientific team in Mexico discover a pool of unusual baby "octopus-like" specimens. Gathering a few for analysis back at the lab, it is soon discovered that the critters belong to a gangly six-foot half man/half octopus-like creature, that's pretty angry and wants her 'babies' returnedâ€¦

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A scheming widow hatches a bold plan to acquire her late husband's inheritance, unaware that she is being targeted by an ax murderer who lurks in the family's estate.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A scheming widow hatches a bold plan to acquire her late husband's inheritance, unaware that she is being targeted by an ax murderer who lurks in the family's estate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In postwar Vienna, Austria, Holly Martins, a writer of pulp Westerns, arrives penniless as a guest of his childhood chum Harry Lime, only to learn he has died. Martins develops a conspiracy theory after learning of a "third man" present at the time of Harry's death, running into interference from British officer Major Calloway, and falling head-over-heels for Harry's grief-stricken lover, Anna.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Seymour works in a skid row florist shop and is in love with his beautiful co-worker, Audrey. He creates a new plant that not only talks but cannot survive without human flesh and blood.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seymour works in a skid row florist shop and is in love with his beautiful co-worker, Audrey. He creates a new plant that not only talks but cannot survive without human flesh and blood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Deep in the desert, a rural American family is forced to endure a night of inter-dimensional, extra terrestrial terror when a UFO appears over their home.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deep in the desert, a rural American family is forced to endure a night of inter-dimensional, extra terrestrial terror when a UFO appears over their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Han Wu-song, an antique collector, gets killed while appraising a bronze horse rider statue which trader Wang Dae-in has stolen from a tomb. Dae-in dies on the scene and Wu-song leaves the killer's name on the cave wall before he dies. Dae-in's son Wang Gak thinks Wu-Song killed his father and fights with his son Jung-pa. Trader Kwan and her daughter Mi-ryung stop the fight. Jung-pa and Mi-ryung's love is disturbed by Ju-yang. Gak and Jung-pa chase him to find Wu-song's body with Ju-yang's name on the wall but Mi-ryung appeals them not to kill...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The head of a major cosmetics company experiments on herself with a youth formula made from royal jelly extracted from wasps, but the formula's side effects have deadly consequences.

But violence descends on Ellen's household willy-nilly when the U.S. President passes through town... and slightly psycho hired assassin John Baron finds the Benson home ideal for an ambush.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海上救難隊員阿傑為了生計及克服之前同伴遇難的陰影,再次乘坐漁船出海謀生,卻再次遭遇巨大的危機。在船上的人不僅要面對惡劣的暴雨天氣,還有海底未知生物正對著他們虎視眈眈。在茫茫大海中,猙獰相對的眾人更必須..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navy officer Ah Jie returns to the fleet to earn a living and tries to recover from the trauma of his comrades death. The fleet encounters severe rainstorm and has to face an unknown sea creature. In the face of adversity, everyone on board must overcome the challenges to trust and support each other in order to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國員警王之章的兒子因鴉片而亡。他痛恨舊社會犯罪橫行,封建思想荼毒百姓,因此偽裝成道士潛入當地商人陳老爺家調查鴉片走私案件,期間卻遇到連環殺人事件。身為員警的王之章為了職責及為兒子報仇,誓要抓住兇手,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Policeman Wang hates crime in the city and the feudalism that lead to his sons death by opium. Disguised as a Taoist priest, he investigates opium smuggling in a merchants home and uncovers a series of murders. Driven by duty and revenge, Wang vows to find the murderer, destroy the stored opium and restore peace in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀七十年代,香港在英國殖民統治下貪腐嚴重,黑惡勢力橫行,毒梟坤哥及豪哥大賺不義之財。廉政公署人員白玫瑰奉命潛伏到黑幫大佬豪哥身邊收集罪證。玫瑰與豪哥日漸熟識,兩人互生情愫。面對一面是將毒梟繩之以法..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Drug lords Kun and Hao prosper amidst a corrupt landscape in the 1970s Hong Kong. ICAC officer Rose embarks on a mission to infiltrate Haos gang to gather evidence. However, as Rose and Hao fall in love, she faces a heart-wrenching dilemma — choosing between her duty to bring him down and the irresistible pull of their intensifying romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋朝年間,法醫宋慈來到長汀縣任職。一天晚上,突然有一男一女同時喪命,宋得知後立刻介入調查,驗屍過後發現事有蹊蹺,並不是簡單的殺人案。此時宋想到了丹青,可以說在長汀縣沒有丹不知道的事情。倆人於是合作找尋..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Song dynasty, Changdings newly appointed forensic scientist, Song Ci, probes into the sudden deaths of a man and a woman. His inquest reveals a mysterious murder plot, and Song Ci decides to join forces with Dan Qing, who knows everything about Changding County, to unravel the truth behind the murders.

epg.programme_title_tc: 封神榜: 決戰萬仙陣
epg.programme_title_en: The First Myth Clash of Gods
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商朝末年,紂王暴虐殘害百姓。與此同時,通天教的仙人們接二連三地因為出手阻撓薑子牙帶領的周軍而喪命。通天教主因此動怒,憤然與申公豹聯手,利用萬仙殺陣企圖一舉清除周軍。薑子牙也結集楊戩、哪吒等眾仙一起對抗..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Shang dynasty, the deities of Tong Tian Cult are killed by the Zhou army led by Jiang Zi Ya. Fueled by anger, the Cult leader unites with Shen Gong Pao to exterminate the Zhou army by setting up a thousand deities trap. Meanwhile, Jiang Zi Ya join forces with Yang Jian, Na Zha and other deities to fight the evil forces and rescue mankind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 火鍋店在香港深受街坊歡迎,店少東從父親手中接棒經營後卻遇上特殊時期,生意受挫,但少東仍然咬緊牙關,不肯辭退員工,期望生活早日重歸正常。一天,匪徒把火鍋店變成挾持人質的犯罪現場,而員工,顧客及未婚妻生命..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While hotpot restaurants thrive in Hong Kong, a young man taking over his fathers hotpot business faces tough times ahead. He remains resilient and insists on keeping all his staffs, hoping for a turnaround. When gangsters hold his staffs, customers and fiancée hostage in the restaurant one day, he vows to fight back and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 某朝年間,齊王殺兄長靈宗奪位,天下動盪。此時忠威鏢局負責護送一張神秘藏寶圖到杭州府,用以資助鎮南將軍起兵復辟,及幫助靈宗的舊太子“花月明重掌江山社稷。而崑崙派掌門高照受命於齊王,負責剿滅餘黨及安排奪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Qi kills his brother and seizes the throne, causing chaos in the country. When a convoy escorts the treasure map to help the former prince regain his position, Emperor Qi assigns Kun Lun Cult master to eliminate the rebels and seize the map, causing great danger to the convoy and martial artists along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年青鐵匠呂三思偶遇自己崇拜的大俠百里無憂。他幫助大俠押送西廠走狗何清纓,但何卻對他說了另一個版本的故事,說她是被西廠迫害,而百里才是出賣義士的走狗!事情越來越可疑,何不一定是走狗,而百里也可能不是大俠..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young blacksmith Lui encounters his idol, Swordsman Bai Li, and helps Bai deport He Qing Ying, a lackey of the emperors secret agency. However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弟弟杜家豪在上水鎮被水猴子殘殺,民國女法醫清伶為了探尋真相便前往上水鎮探尋原因。在這詭異的村莊,關於水猴子復仇的“詛咒接二連三發生。清伶携槍勇闖水怪禁地黑木林,而她力憑科學文明剷除水猴子的封建迷信,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brothers murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀,尤如白天,然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩,更流傳著“點燈殺人的傳說,以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後,發現了很多反常之處,後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追,倆人為了還百姓一個太平安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青雲堂的女掌門於勝男為了完成病重父親的願望,急於結婚。她在相親時認識了牛多多,而牛在威逼利誘下簽了假結婚協議。正當勝男漸漸被牛的善良和純真吸引,多年前被勝男父親逐出師門的師兄林傑歸來,並用牛威脅勝男接..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yu Sheng Nan rushes to get married to fulfil her dying fathers wish and forces Niu, a man she just knew, to sign a bogus marriage agreement. As Yu gradually falls for Niu, her expelled senior returns and forces Yu to accept his duel challenge by threatening her with Nius safety. A deadly martial arts fight has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白澤和淩風自幼一起在崑崙派長大,二人因誤入秘境,得到了昊天鏡及絕世魔功。後因淩風修煉魔功之事曝光,兩人被逐出師門,來到白馬鎮,在這裡找到心愛之人。不料崑崙派突然來追殺他們,使淩風愛人慘死,令他墜入魔道..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bai and Ling are expelled from Kunlun Sect after acquiring a mystical mirror and a forbidden martial arts skill. They both found love along the way, but when the Kunlun sect members hunt them down and kill Lings lover, Ling is devastated and decides to turn evil. To uphold justice, Bai subdues Ling and found the Shushan Sect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏年間,新君登基,時局未穩,遊牧民族柔然對魏國虎視眈眈。為牽制柔然,大魏公主和親北涼,不料卻被柔然猛將綿爾圖擄走。綿挾持公主,要魏國在兩日內交出十座城池為贖金。魏國將軍花木蘭臨危受命,更啟用死囚慕容..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Northern Wei empire faces raids from the nomadic Rou Ran tribe. The princess of Wei is kidnapped by a Rou Ran general, who demands ten cities as ransom. Weis General Mulan forms a special task force to rescue the princess and a fatal battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 錦毛鼠白玉堂因不滿展昭被賜禦貓封號,同結拜兄弟“陷空島五鼠在東京火神節上盜取火神像,以此羞辱負責巡防治安的展昭。不料二人在爭搶火神像時,祭祀大典和整個煙花坊突起水澆不滅的大火,無辜百姓被燒成灰燼。白..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Upset by Constable Zhangs prestigious title of Imperial Cat, Bai and his sworn brother steal a god statue during the Tokyo God of Fire Festival to embarass Zhang. Tragedy strikes as a fire breaks out, claiming innocent lives. Bai and Zhang join forces to investigate the truth behind the incident and vow to take down the real culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三國時期,一代名將關羽在麥城之戰被吳國將軍潘璋所殺,青龍偃月刀也被奪走。兩年後蜀國君主劉備親征為關羽報仇,任命關羽之子關興組成小隊,秘密執行破壞吳軍水寨防禦中樞的任務。關興突破重重險阻,最終與殺父仇人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Pan Zhang of the Wus killed General Guan Yu and took away his Green Dragon Crescent Blade. Two years later, Emperor Liu Bei brings an army led by Guan Xing, the son of Guan Yu, to attack Wus waterfront defence. Guan Xing overcomes all challenges and fights against General Pan Zhang to avenge his fathers death, and reclaims the blade.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十年前,身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假,不料突發遇到颱風,張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質,妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭,不料又一場颱風來襲,妻子被颱風所困,女兒又被人綁架。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 10 years ago, rescue team leader Zhang suffered the loss of his son in a landslide during a typhoon. His anguish leads to his wifes request for divorce. While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐時期垂拱元年,武則天率領百官坐龍船夜巡運河,各人奔向龍門只為一睹天后聖容,沒想到卻在運河之中遭遇龍形異獸衝撞龍船,引起了百姓的議論,認為是不祥之兆。武則天對此事件勃然大怒,召見狄仁傑前去調查運河龍王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Empress Wu and her officials patrol the Grand Canal one night. As the crowd rushes to see her in person, a dragon monster appears and hits on the vessel. This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐時期垂拱元年,武則天率領百官坐龍船夜巡運河,各人奔向龍門只為一睹天后聖容,沒想到卻在運河之中遭遇龍形異獸衝撞龍船,引起了百姓的議論,認為是不祥之兆。武則天對此事件勃然大怒,召見狄仁傑前去調查運河龍王..

This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,水派幻術師裴靜之為搶奪法寶大開殺戒,最終被火派幻術師空空封印,之後空空帶著一孤兒卓非凡離開。二十年後,裴解開封印想再次奪寶,將空空殺害。空空死前將自己撫養的卓託付給落霞飛學習火術。卓發誓要為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Pei of the Water Cult is trapped by Kong in a seal as he tries to kill to find the treasure. Kong leaves with an orphan Fang and 20 years later, Pei unseals himself to find the treasure again and kills Kong. As Fang learns the Fire skills from his master Kong, he vows to avenge his death but then discovers his ties to the Water Cult.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1996年之前的香港,雪麗在自己的婚禮現場遭遇劫匪挾持,並目睹丈夫死於匪徒槍下。雪現於一家射箭館任職,在颱風之夜意外滯留大樓內,並目擊當年同一幫匪徒在大廈內殺人。在逃亡過程中,她遇到了同為滯留者的盲眼..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During her wedding in 1996, Xue Li is taken hostage by gangsters and saw her husband being killed. One night in a typhoon, Xue Li is forced to stay at her workplace in a building, where she witnesses another murder by the same group of gangsters. As she tries to escape, she meets a blind old man and they must fight for survival together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗美援朝戰爭時期,志願軍三排排長孟大關臨危受命,帶領小隊前去解救被困敵後的偵察排。經歷了一系列艱難險阻,孟與由杜川帶領的偵察排終於成功匯合。為了避免部隊有更大傷亡,孟與杜在危急關頭果斷決定,要困死那個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meng, a Volunteer Army platoon leader, is commissioned to rescue a platoon in captive. Through arduous trials, Meng teams up with another platoon leader, Du. They decide to contain the enemys artillery supply to reduce casualties, and vow to dedicate themselves to fight against the foes for their people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏時期柔然軍入侵邊境,花木蘭為老父出征,女扮男裝入伍來到邊關要塞常平倉。木蘭在戰場上奮勇殺敵,屢建戰功,取得多次勝利。正當眾人歡慶之際,敵人將數量足有百萬隻老鼠投入城中,趁亂攻城,令他們受到重創。為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mulan disguises herself as a man to join the army on behalf of her elderly father. She fights gallantly and vanquishes her enemies in rounds of battles. While they celebrate their victory, the enemy sets millions of rats into the city, followed by a raid. Mulan fearlessly defends the city, risking her life to ensure the peoples safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王生偶然救了狐妖香兒,在不知香兒真實身分的情況下將她收留在家中,並對她心生愛慕,甚至想納她為妾。原來香兒也是被巫山老妖所控制,操縱她在人間作惡害人。王生和香兒最後能否走在一起,人和妖又能否相戀?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Sheng fortuitously rescues the fox demon Xiang Er and brings her home. Unaware of her identity, he falls in love with her, hoping for her to become his concubine. However, Xiang Er is manipulated by the old demoness to do evil and harm people. Will their paranormal love triumph over darkness, allowing them to live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一心想要去學習嶗山道法的少年王生,終獲高人指點,學成歸家,之後卻把師父“不可生邪念的教誨丟在腦後,學了點法術便打算用來行竊。隅然王解開了自己身世之謎,又經過幾番歷練才終於開悟,決定用屬於自己的方式來..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Wang Sheng aspires to learn Laoshan Taoism skills. Under the tutelage of his master, Wang acquires the skills but succumbs to greed, forsaking the masters teachings of Think No Evil. As Wang finds out about his own identity, his epiphany sparks enlightenment, prompting him to forge his unique path in vanquishing the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國女學生林家英親眼目睹姐姐被軍閥馬世傑迫害致死而卻無能為力,並在隨後趕到的何美梓口中得知姐姐原來是秘密特工隊“魅影的一員。為替姐姐報仇,英加入魅影特工隊,接受訓練成為一名美豔特工。在一次執行任務中..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young student Ying helplessly witness her sister being persecuted to death by a warlord. When she realizes her sister is a member of the secret agency Phantom, Ying vows to avenge her death and joins Phantom. She eventually becomes a pretty secret agent but soon unveils the secret behind Phantom during a mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,陰陽鎮遭恐怖詛咒,傳說進去後誰也出不去,離開的人都會神秘死亡。尋寶人閻陽一和寶葫蘆誤入了陰陽鎮,雖然閻不相信傳說,但他在鎮上卻常常遇到可怕的事情。然而讓閻和寶更沒想到的是,在詛咒之下的詭異小..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yin Yang Town has been cursed during the Republican period and legend has it that anyone who leaves the town will be mysteriously killed. Two treasure hunters who do not believe the legend inadvertently enter the town and experience horrifying events. The real surprise lies in an astonishing secret in this cursed town...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期上海,怪物獵人宇文預測到上豪大飯店有怪獸出現,而當怪獸現身襲擊表演的花旦顧青時,宇文英雄救美,打斷富少警探天明的公開表白。之後三人被捲入了一系列的奇怪案件,在調查過程中,所有線索都指向一個塵封..

As the trio gets involved in a series of mysterious cases, they find out that the cases are related to a legend about a giant monster who will soon be returning to the world...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Jiang Cheng, the secretive Xi He Hall controls the city’s underworld while hunting its legendary former sniper, “Ghost Hand”, branded a traitor. When street hustler Lu Lan impersonates the infamous marksman to make a living, he is captured by the organisation’s deadliest assassin and drawn into a deadly conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成,包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事;《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會,卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事;《官能許願》超能力男孩,以器官為代價,拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事;及..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年的龍雲鎮,相傳鎮子發現寶藏後逐漸怪事不斷,接連出現少女家中被殺。同時,寶藏消息也招來各路心懷不軌的“江湖術士紛紛前來尋寶。巡捕隊的林隊長迫於鎮長壓力,決定聯手死刑犯計連營一起找出真凶及解開背..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of mysterious incidents happen when treasure is discovered in Long Yun Town, including killings of girls. As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

epg.programme_title_en: The Thousand Faces of Fei Jia
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王小俠本是一個胸無大志,在市井街頭討生活的小鎮青年,與父親老瞎子生活在十隱鎮,唯一的願望就是能治好父親的眼疾。一次偶然令王小俠邂逅了沈藍兒,並意外地捲入了一場陰謀之中。而王小俠為了找能治好父親的眼疾方..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young man Wang Xiao Xia resides in a small town with his blind father. His only desire is to cure his fathers eye disease. One day, he encounters Shen Nan Er by chance and gets embroiled in a conspiracy. In his quest to heal his fathers eyes, he goes to the Qi Yin Sect and finally unveils his hidden identity, which was concealed by his father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 初任上海警察隊長的陳虎接到一樁命案,軍政部部長之子何滿君離奇死亡。何是聖馬丁高中的一名學生,為了獲得破案信息,陳喬裝學生混入學校。他一邊查案,一邊與各方勢力展開較量,而何之死迷霧重重,一個又一個嫌疑人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The son of a minister is mysteriously killed. The newly appointed police inspector Chen Fu, goes undercover as a secondary student to investigate the case. As he carries on investigation in the school, Chen encounters different potential suspects, making the case more mysterious. What is the cause of the murder and who is the killer?

Unfortunately, a sudden headache hits Tie and he gets into an argument with the boss of the debt collection agency, putting more strain on the relationship of the two lovers.

However, there is a rumour that no one can leave the basement alive. Determined to save his wife and free the prisoners, Shen embarks on a dangerous journey through the citys labyrinth of mechanism.

After knowing their capabilites and responsibilities, they resume their identities and team up to fight the villains.

Evading the Queens pursuit, they uncover the Deer Kings secret with their allies, restoring peace to the village and the kingdom.

When Sect leader Yans name surfaces, she is forced to flee but meets a compassionate thief, Chu. Together they return to the Tang Sect and uncover the truth behind the conspiracy to prove her innocence.

They must team up to complete the adventures on the island and win the grand prize. Unknowingly though, they become the victims of a complicated and evil plan.

He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. As Tang discovers that the evidence of Fengs rebellion is hidden in a painting, he vows to uncover the plot.

During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

As Justice Bao, Zhan Zhao and Gong Sun Ce secretly preside over the trials involving evil spirits, the disciples of “Wai Jiu Liu” try to poison Bao and hedge a huge plot. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

Due to humans fault, the island is now a monster paradise. The students must defeat the monster to escape and as they explore further, they uncover a hidden conspiracy behind the trip.
