epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leaders of Long Sect and Yi Sect battled and the Yi Sect was defeated. 12 years later, Lang Yan, Long Sects leader, is poisoned by the spider demon. As Longs guard and Ji Xin investigate the case, they uncover a plot by Yis descendants to unleash spider demons onto Long to create chaos. The battle between good and evil will soon begin....

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,生活在洛陽洛河水兩端但不同出生的兩個少女意外被捲入懸案之中。一位是金吾衛隊長的女兒趙青青,另一位是生於市井底層的女孩小騙子。她們一同遭遇在洛陽城內一連串匪夷所思的離奇案件,二人組成了臨時搭檔..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Zhou dynasty, two girls living in two ends of the Luo He River come from diverse backgrounds - one is a captains daughter and another is a common swindler - and they encounter a series of mysterious events in Luo Yang City. Both team up to investigate a series of bizarre cases, to uphold justice and to maintain order amidst a social upheaval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,生活在洛陽洛河水兩端但不同出生的兩個少女意外被捲入懸案之中。一位是金吾衛隊長的女兒趙青青,另一位是生於市井底層的女孩小騙子。她們一同遭遇在洛陽城內一連串匪夷所思的離奇案件,二人組成了臨時搭檔..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Zhou dynasty, two girls living in two ends of the Luo He River come from diverse backgrounds - one is a captains daughter and another is a common swindler - and they encounter a series of mysterious events in Luo Yang City. Both team up to investigate a series of bizarre cases, to uphold justice and to maintain order amidst a social upheaval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,發丘一脈的傳人張聞風為了尋找父親失蹤真相,及阻止境外惡勢力盜取不死神樹,與夥伴踏上兇險萬分的古墓之旅,但他們卻誤闖誤撞進入了崑崙山,一個藏有 百神 的上古神跡崑崙墟。然而令張意想不到的是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zheng Min Feng embarks on a thrilling journey with his friend to an ancient tomb to find his missing father and protect the immortal tree. However, they mistakenly go to Mount Kwun Lun, the sacred site with One Hundred Gods. Amidst the creepy legend and perilous journey, they must confront the enigmatic depths of the human heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盛世大唐氣象萬千,各色人物皆在江湖中行走,身懷絕技的盲眼“捉刀人成瞎子,遇上慘遭滅門和淩辱的酒家女倪燕。原本不與人有過多交情的成瞎子卻意外與她產生關聯,亦逐漸被捲入一場勢力龐大的暗黑紛爭中。成瞎子開..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talents are found everywhere in the Tang dynasty, including Blind man Cheng. He meets a barmaid Ni Yan, who has lost her family and gotten abused, and they become friends. This entangles Cheng into a big triad conflict, and as he starts his journey of revenge, his true identity is also revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學狂人私下研發了一種具有交感神經、高度發達的人形機器人。偶然地,機器人獲得了獨立意識,更通過黑科技手段換取了貌美女子蘇辛的皮膚及軀殼,接近蘇的男友王升。另外,不斷有離奇殺人案發生,引起了警員李洞賓的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A science maniac creates an advanced humanlike robot, which accidentally develops its own thinking. It takes on the appearance of Susan by evil technology, and approaches her boyfriend. Meanwhile, police officer Li investigates a series of mysterious murder cases. A battle between humans and robots is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 風暴安保公司猛虎小隊負責安保及營救工作。小隊接到新任務,受到國際和平基金會僱傭,護送一輛裝滿水源淨化器和大量農作物種子的卡車前往薩基亞村落進行民間救援。可當地遭遇無政府組織入侵,途經區域處於戰火地帶。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Tiger Team of Storm Security Company is assigned by the International Peace Foundation to escort a truck filled with water purifiers and planting seeds to Sakiya village. Despite an anarchist attack, the team strives to overcome the fierce battle so that the supplies can be delivered to the villagers successfully.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年前,一顆外太空隕石載著三顆晶瑩玉石墜落人間一村莊,傳聞任何人進入此村莊的森林都會遇到山鬼,而從沒人能成功走出來。二十年後傳說中的山鬼又再次出現,而且引發了多宗血案。當案件被深入調查時,原本被掩蓋..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two decades ago, a meteorite carrying three crystals struck a village on Earth. Rumor has it that anyone entering the village forest will be haunted by a mountain ghost and trapped. After 20 years, the ghost reappears, causing a series of murders. As investigation begins, the hidden truth behind the mystery is gradually uncovered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 老實刻板的理髮師杜常勇喪妻後獨自撫養女兒。他想女兒能繼承自己的理髮店,但女兒一心只想參加新秀比賽節目當明星。二人缺乏理解加上代溝,引發父女之間頻繁爭吵。在一次爭吵後,杜到天台勸女兒回家,父女兩突然被宇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Honest hairstylist Du Chang Rong, raises his daughter on his own and hopes that she will take over his salon. However his daughter dreams of becoming an artiste. In a fight between Du and his daughter on the roof, they accidentally got struck by lightning and discover that they have swapped identities after regaining consciousness!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河北省的秋風縣在半個月前寡婦何秀琴在城外被匪徒殺害後,縣城一座名叫赤橋的橋上開始出現「女鬼」。縣太爺陳之章命令捕快郭幻率領眾人限期捉鬼,當郭抓住了裝鬼大漢夏蟲,得知夏裝鬼的理由,才發現原來背後竟藏著一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female ghost is sighted at a bridge following the murder of a widow two weeks ago in Qiu Feng County. Inspector Guo is assigned to hunt down the ghost promptly. Upon investigation, Guo discovers a man named Xia Chong disguising himself as the female ghost, leading to the revelation of a peculiar murder case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒精英的閆鵬在追捕毒販赤那時,同事兼好友阿古拉犧牲於毒販手中。之後鵬來到阿古拉家照顧他的家人,卻不料碰上真正的赤那到來,要阿古拉父親帶路,幫他逃離邊境。鵬隨後才知道,先前被他消滅的毒販竟然是赤那的孿..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agula, a friend and coworker of Narcotic agent Yan, is killed by the drug dealer Chi Na. While Yan takes care of Agulas family, he encounters Chi Na who wants to flee the country with the help of Agulas father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李道師聽從師傅之命下山歷練,本以為妖邪都是殘忍惡毒,卻在路上經歷了三件事,讓他悟出一些道理。當他看到黑魚精為救她無情的丈夫犧牲自己;一對相愛的戀人為了在一起而放棄生命,共同融入畫中;刺蝟精捨身為報答乾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Li believes all demons to be evil until he encounters three events - a fish demon who sacrifices herself for her heartless husband, a pair of lovers who commit suicide for love, and a hedgehog monster who sacrifices himself for his godfather. These encounters make Master Li question who is more evil, humans or demons?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝崇禎末年,正派與魔教勢不兩立互有爭鬥。白髮魔女練霓裳因此陷入一場江湖的腥風血雨當中,內裡更蘊含著重大陰謀。錦衣衛常安奉命暗中調查白髮魔女練霓裳,在追查的道路上,常安對練霓裳產生了莫名的情愫,要為練..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張騫奉漢武帝之命率領百餘人組成使團出使大月氏,中途卻遭匈奴截殺及俘虜。張及部份生還的使團成員淪為階下囚,被軟禁十年之久,原本要實行密謀多年的逃跑計畫也被突如其來的一場匈奴與大漢將軍的戰爭打破。儘管如此..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Appointed by the Emperor Han, Zhang leads a diplomatic mission to Greater Rouzhi, but they are either killed or captured by the Huns on the way. Zhang and the captives are imprisoned for 10 years and the battle between the Huns and Han destroyed their long-awaited escape plan. Zhang vows to overcome the trials and bring the captives back to Han.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年前,大巫祭率領暗黑一族侵襲人族,戰神張赤炎不惜犧牲自己喚醒戰神劍,才得以擊退暗黑族。如今黑暗力量再次蘇醒,蠢蠢欲動,戰神之子張珂與及雲柃、福喜再次踏上喚醒戰神劍的旅程,而張珂也在戰鬥中成長為新戰..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 20 years ago, God of War Zhang Chi Yan sacrificed himself to restore the power of his sword so as to defeat the Tribe of Darkness. As the tribe becomes active again, Zhangs son, Ke, and his friends set out to restore the swords power. Zhang Ke is now the new God of War with the sword, leading his people to fight a deadly battle with the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張宸是軍事戰術教官,經常輾轉於世界各地為安保公司做戰術培訓。一次意外中,張被捲入一宗謀殺案,成了當地的通緝犯。張被迫逃亡,並在同伴初五的幫助下找到了謀殺案倖存者黛米。三人相互配合,開始著手調查,在槍林..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Military instructor Zhang Zhen accidentally gets involved in a murder and becomes the suspect. He is forced to flee and with the help of his companion, Zhang finds the sole survivor of the murder. The trio launches an investigation and strives to uncover the truth, which seems to be connected to a human smuggling gang and a military organization.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葛振為了拯救車遲國,加入了殺手組織都司府,成為十二暗軍的預備役,專門執行朝廷的秘密任務。葛振在師傅那裡學到白門五甲絕技,在查案時邂逅秋葵,兩人互生情愫。與此同時十二暗軍中最強的午馬被神秘人殺死,最終葛..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his country, Ge Zhen joins a killer squad assigned for secret government missions. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清乾隆年間,紅花會老舵主于萬亭病逝,命其義子陳家洛受命接任掌門之位。之後紅花會多個分舵遭受襲擊,而四當家文泰來下落不明。陳與消息靈通的玉如意達成交易,兩人與幾位當家合作營救文。其後陳發現文的失蹤可能是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the societys members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fus treasure. Meanwhile, Yus real identity also surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔族在雲盛皇朝興風作浪,皇帝突死於怪病,在臨終前將盛寧公主下嫁伏龍大將軍白奕。公主向太后請求悔婚遭拒絕,漸漸兩人相處後關係緩和,公主發現自已對白奕已芳心暗許。及後公主被魔族尾火虎挾持,白奕在混戰中救出..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon cult prevails in the Yun Sheng dynasty. The Emperor arranges the princess to marry General Bai Yi before he dies, but the princess wants to end her engagement. When the princess eventually falls for Bai, she is kidnapped by the demon cult and Bai is killed in a fight while trying to save her. Will the couple be separated forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公即將在突破最後一層成為降龍羅漢的關鍵時刻,感應到白水鎮村民有難,於是他放棄修行前往白水鎮解救百姓。在這裡他遇到了假扮濟公的黃元蠱惑百姓,差點把濟公燒死,但最終黃元被濟公所感化,並幫助濟公一起降魔伏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ji Gong is about to transform into the Arhat when he foresees a threat to the villagers in town and decides to sacrifice his practice to rescue them. He encounters Huang, who impersonates him and bewitches the villagers, leading Ji Gong to be nearly burnt alive. When Huang is finally enlightened by Ji Gong, he joins him to subdue the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公即將在突破最後一層成為降龍羅漢的關鍵時刻,感應到白水鎮村民有難,於是他放棄修行前往白水鎮解救百姓。在這裡他遇到了假扮濟公的黃元蠱惑百姓,差點把濟公燒死,但最終黃元被濟公所感化,並幫助濟公一起降魔伏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ji Gong is about to transform into the Arhat when he foresees a threat to the villagers in town and decides to sacrifice his practice to rescue them. He encounters Huang, who impersonates him and bewitches the villagers, leading Ji Gong to be nearly burnt alive. When Huang is finally enlightened by Ji Gong, he joins him to subdue the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天爺是江城最大的毒梟,行事謹慎,從不親自參與交易。平江市公安局禁毒大隊的大隊長陳昌榮為了抓住天爺,自願成為臥底進入天爺的販毒團夥,終極對決一觸即發。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Tien, the most powerful drug dealer in Jiang City, is always on the alert and never gets involved in any drug trafficking personally. To arrest Master Tien, the captain of the narcotics team at Ping Jiang City volunteers to be an undercover in Master Tiens drug gang, resulting in a fierce combat.

epg.programme_title_en: The Whirlwind of Sword and Fairy
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 百年前,仙劍門祖師爺張掌門與異人首領幽皇大戰七天七夜,最終打敗幽皇,並將異人族兵器「九黎」封印。百年後,仙劍門弟子張之霖成為新掌門。此時發現鎮上女人離奇失蹤,原來是幽皇吸食女人精魄練就神功。仙劍門布下..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 100 years ago, Master Zhang triumphed over Inhuman clan leader, Emperor Yu, in a fierce 7-day duel and sealed their weapons after that. A century later, Zhangs disciple, Lin, assumes leadership and discovers that the spirits of the vanished women are devoured by Emperor Yu for boosting his power. The war between good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 元朝末年,一個名為修羅幕主的神秘組織聲稱擁有武林至寶八極玄盒。他們邀請了頂尖的武林高手參加武林大會,事實上想用秘製毒藥控制他們為組織效力。太極宗師張三豐為要揭露組織的陰謀參加了武林大會,最終解開了八極..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Yuan dynasty, a secret gang invites top martial arts masters to an event to showcase a martial arts treasure, with an intention to drug the masters so that they fall under their control and can serve the gang. Tai Chi master Zhang San Feng attends the event to uncover their plot and successfully destroys the evil gang in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘇家布行二房長子蘇文興,渴望繼承家業,卻在與堂妹蘇檀兒的較量中被擊敗。興偶然得知他在眾人眼中只是一個吉祥物,為了證明自己的能力,興決心往外闖一番事業,但卻遭受連連挫折。正當他絕望之際,一位舊日同窗高甜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Su Wen Xing aspires to take over the familys textile shop, but loses the control to his cousin. To prove himself, he sets out on a journey to find his own success but faces repeated setbacks. In despair, he reconnects with an old classmate who collaborates with him on a business venture, resulting in a series of amusing and chaotic escapades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武則天時期,京城長安接連發生了好幾次離奇死亡案件,因為死因不明,以致忠烈祠飛天壁畫顯靈殺人的謠言愈演愈烈,百姓紛紛認為是天降不祥,人心惶惶。在地方屢破奇案的狄仁傑奉命調查此案,最終不僅破除了謠言,也通..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the era of Empress Wu, rumours about mysterious murder cases are spreading in Chang An City. The people are worried and see it as an ominous sign. Detective Di is assigned to investigate the case, and not only did he manage to unravel the mystery, he also uncovers the truth and finds the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇門派和五毒派為江湖兩大門派,而這兩大派為了“皇家龍種花落誰家而各施各法,奇門派誤打誤撞中揭穿了皇叔試圖阻止皇帝有子嗣的陰謀。皇叔派五毒派弟子秀明試圖毒害皇太子,而奇門則派出多美。多美為人善良,且鍾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qimen and Wudu Cults both get involved in the imperial succession plan. Qimen Cult accidentally uncovers the conspiracy of the Emperors uncle, who enlists a Wudu disciple to poison the Crown prince. Meanwhile, Qimens Duo Mei falls for a royal guard and joins forces with him to uncover the evil plot of the emperors uncle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 老段多年前因涉嫌一樁案件入獄,而剛出獄的他為搞清當年真相,決定要謀劃一場大騙局。怎料此行動卻捲入了他與三個前妻所生的三個性格不同的孩子。一家四口一邊聯手抗敵,一邊互相搞破壞,而這一切都逐漸走向失控及不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Released from jail after an alleged offence, Lao Duan plans a scam to uncover the truth behind the past happenings. His three kids, each of distinct character, get involved in the plan. The family join hands to defeat the enemy, but at the same time, also making troubles for themselves.  As the situation spirals, the ending ia anyones guess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群偷獵者在公海上對鯊魚進行殘酷的捕殺,激怒了大白鯊。偷獵者死於鯊魚的口中,之後盛怒的大白鯊把注意力轉向了在附近遊艇上慶祝畢業的四個好友。於是,四人與大白鯊之間展開了一場激烈的生死搏鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A big white shark is enraged following a shark hunt by the poachers, who are then killed by it. Fueled by anger, the shark turns to attack four friends who are celebrating their graduation on a yacht. A life-and-death struggle between the four friends and the big white shark has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大陳天啟年間,發生了西域舞姬控物懸浮事件,負責靈異怪事的部門“夜行司派出陳淩前往無相城調查。城內叛徒木道人假意幫陳,其實想奪走城內的異能植物日輪花,讓大陳百姓感染花毒癲狂噬人,以報服大陳和無相城..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Chen Dynasty, Chen Ling is assigned to investigate a supernatural case in Wu Xiang City. There, a man who pretends to help Chen Ling wants to steal a supernatural plant whose poison will cause people to bite each other, so as to take revenge on Chen and the master who killed his tribe. A fierce battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在香港讀書的少年葉問,意外卷入英國斯塔克集團綁架中國婦女走私到海外的人口販賣案中。葉挺身而出怒打綁匪解救出一批被拐的女子,不料遭到激烈報覆,更連累了身邊的朋友。葉問開始反思,知道個人力量不足夠對抗斯塔..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Ip Man battles a British kidnapping gang involved in trafficking Chinese women. As he fights to rescue the captives, he becomes a target of revenge, even endangering his friends. Recognizing his limits, Ip Man works with the patriots to expose the gang’s thrilling conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傅炎為了拯救瀕臨死亡的藍墨伊,毅然前往上古戰場神佑之地,尋找神炎來救藍。上古戰場分三層,他們剛從外層降服了守護獸赤墨玄蛟時,便遇到蒼岩宗宗主蒼石靈君。然而傅及石二人要爭奪對方的半張藏寶圖,在一番激戰後..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: u sets out to find the Godly Flame and save the dying Nan. On his way, he encounters Master Shi of Can Yan Sect when vanquishing a guardian beast. Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. Both decide to share the map and team up to search for the treasure and the Godly Flame.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少林習武歸來的方世玉,本打算過平常人的生活,但剛回到家鄉肇慶便牽扯到一樁貪腐案中。朝廷貪官的爪牙鄂爾多帶隊殺人滅口並企圖銷毀證據,方世玉雖面對好友周蓉的慘死,母親被擒為人質,但卻面無懼色,決意反抗到底..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Having mastered the Shaolin martial arts, Fang Shi Yu yearns for a tranquil existence back home but becomes entangled in a corruption scandal. The governors henchman assigns a squad to eliminate witnesses and erase all evidence. Despite facing his best friends death and his mothers captivity, Fang vows to fight against the forces of evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 重案組臥底警員山哥向高級督察唯Sir發送線報,说大毒梟金先生將會親自主持一宗涉及金額達二千萬美元的毒品交易。其實這是個為了找出誰是臥底而設計的陷阱,山哥身份暴露後被黑幫追殺,而其臥底身份也突然被警方刪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Undercover cop Shan tips Inspector Wai on a USD20 million drug trade that will be dealt directly by drug boss Jin. However, this is a trap set by Jin to find the undercover. When Shans identity is revealed, he is hunted by the drug gang while his police identity has also been deleted. To prove himself a cop, Shan must uncover Jins conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋年間,在方圓八百里之地有少俠與飛雲客棧的夥伴們聯手協助將軍李顯忠展開北伐,收復失地。但他們的努力卻遭到副將邵宏淵的嫉妒和破壞,最後導致北伐失敗。眾人非常氣憤,誓要捉拿邵宏淵,並要協助百姓們安全撤離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Song era, a young master and staff at Fei Yun inn aid General Li Xian Zhong to recover the lost territory in a northern expedition. However, Deputy General Shaos jealousy and sabotage cause the mission to fail. Fueled by anger, the team vows to capture Shao while helping the civilians to evacuate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀,尤如白天,然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩,更流傳著“點燈殺人的傳說,以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後,發現了很多反常之處,後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追,倆人為了還百姓一個太平安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人,團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛,公司主要是保護客戶安全,俗稱“保鏢。這天,他們接到一個匿名委託,要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸,之後逸便頻生意外。童發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天意是天界出名的留級生,因前世孽緣未了無法成仙,後來一次意外他無意釋放了雪女令她越獄下凡,在捉拿雪女過程中,天意發現自己竟是害她淪為雪妖的人。為了彌補過錯,天意自願在陰間路上漂泊千年,一番磨難後,二人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tian Yi is destined to fail as an immortal in heaven. When he accidentally frees Snowy and makes her a demon, he wanders in hell for thousand years to right his wrong. After a series of hardships, Snowy and Tian Yi manages to get married, but the heavenly warriors attempt to arrest Snowy. Can the couple live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清河聶氏處理其祖傳藏刀古墓的危機時,兄長聶明玦帶領弟弟聶懷桑倆人攜手共渡難關,合力將古墓復原,確保聶氏族人平安。在過程中二人雖然有矛盾,但在經歷危難後,聶懷桑從膽小怕事的世家子弟變得成熟穩重,而聶明玦..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two brothers, Jue and Sang, team up to restore the ancestral tomb of the Nie Clan and protect the clans safety. Despite conflicts between the siblings, Sang becomes more mature and responsible after overcoming the difficulties. As Jue gets to know his younger brother, he helps prepare him to become the future clan leader.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白澤和淩風自幼一起在崑崙派長大,二人因誤入秘境,得到了昊天鏡及絕世魔功。後因淩風修煉魔功之事曝光,兩人被逐出師門,來到白馬鎮,在這裡找到心愛之人。不料崑崙派突然來追殺他們,使淩風愛人慘死,令他墜入魔道..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bai and Ling are expelled from Kunlun Sect after acquiring a mystical mirror and a forbidden martial arts skill. They both found love along the way, but when the Kunlun sect members hunt them down and kill Lings lover, Ling is devastated and decides to turn evil. To uphold justice, Bai subdues Ling and found the Shushan Sect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三國時期,一代名將關羽在麥城之戰被吳國將軍潘璋所殺,青龍偃月刀也被奪走。兩年後蜀國君主劉備親征為關羽報仇,任命關羽之子關興組成小隊,秘密執行破壞吳軍水寨防禦中樞的任務。關興突破重重險阻,最終與殺父仇人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Pan Zhang of the Wus killed General Guan Yu and took away his Green Dragon Crescent Blade. Two years later, Emperor Liu Bei brings an army led by Guan Xing, the son of Guan Yu, to attack Wus waterfront defence. Guan Xing overcomes all challenges and fights against General Pan Zhang to avenge his fathers death, and reclaims the blade.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋朝年間,法醫宋慈來到長汀縣任職。一天晚上,突然有一男一女同時喪命,宋得知後立刻介入調查,驗屍過後發現事有蹊蹺,並不是簡單的殺人案。此時宋想到了丹青,可以說在長汀縣沒有丹不知道的事情。倆人於是合作找尋..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Song dynasty, Changdings newly appointed forensic scientist, Song Ci, probes into the sudden deaths of a man and a woman. His inquest reveals a mysterious murder plot, and Song Ci decides to join forces with Dan Qing, who knows everything about Changding County, to unravel the truth behind the murders.

epg.programme_title_tc: 武狀元蘇乞兒之天降神諭
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末期,西方列強在中國橫行霸道,百姓民不聊生。此時民間天降“神諭,傳言大清要亡,加上顧命大臣接連暴斃,讓傳言更加沸騰。皇上任命九門提督富察·禦恒徹查此案,富察也請來好友蘇燦幫忙。燦發現刺客應該是用..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Qing dynasty, people are suffering from destitution. A divine omen and death of some ministers have sparked rumours of Qings downfall. Fu Cha is tasked by the Emperor to investigate, so he enlists the help of Su Can, who uncovers a brutal assassination plot involving illusions and unravels the secret behind the case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上陽郡主王萱在與寒族將軍蕭霽新婚之夜,為遵守與愛人三皇子子珩的約定,甘願飲毒酒假死,豈料這一切只是皇權氏族的陰謀算計。王萱傷透了心,為了報仇化身為吸食人血的修羅女,連子珩對她也非常懼怕。然而蕭霽卻對王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Princess Wang fakes death on her wedding day with General Xiao to fulfil her vow with her secret lover. After realizing it was a set up by the Emperor, Wang is devastated and turns into a blood demon to take revenge. However, General Xiao still stands by her side and helps her to uncover the truth behind an even bigger conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明德市郊外發生了一宗拋屍命案,公安局副局長楊棟帶領整個警隊展開深入調查。他們逐步揭開了以企業家林峰為首的頂峰集團涉嫌殺人、放高利貸、及開設賭場等罪行。隨著對掃除黑勢力專案的持續進行,那些無惡不作的犯罪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A police deputy chief leads an investigation about a body discovered in Ming De Town, and gradually unveils a series of crimes, including murder, loan sharking and casino activities by a company owned by entrepreneur Lin Feng. The police go all out to fight vigorously against the criminals as anti-triad operations continue...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 徐震從昏迷中驚醒時,發覺身處在封閉的鐵箱之中,跟著一陣聲響後,鐵箱自動打開。他走出鐵箱,見到一片熱帶叢林,還發現林依娜及其他倖存者,眾人都來自不同國家,然而如何被運到這裡全然不知。大家在叢林中不但要面..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Xu finds himself trapped inside an iron box after awaking from a coma. As the box opens, he finds himself in a tropical forest together with other survivors, all not knowing how they ended up there. Not only do they have to face various crisis and attacks from beasts, they also have to uncover the truth behind it all so as to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孫悟空被壓五指山下四百年時,碰巧被阿一所救。而龍太子得知悟空已逃出,要報當年東海龍宮被毀之仇,便利用悟空昔日好友蛟魔王刺殺悟空,但刺殺失敗,不過阿一被俘虜。為了救阿一,悟空與龍太子從海里打到南天門。最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trapped under Mount Wuzhi for 400 years, the Monkey King is saved by Ah Yi, but is targeted to be assassinated under the Prince Dragons orders. Though the mission fails, Ah Yi is captured and Monkey King battles the Prince Dragon across land and sea to rescue her. He finally redeems himself and returns to Mount Wuzhi to continue his training.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔刀門女弟子雅青初次下山,不慎捲入唐門“蛇人風波,在逃避追殺的途中結識了啞女伏風和江若晨。正當他們陷入絕境時,幸得隱居高人梁玄卿指點知道“蛇人之謎背後隱藏著一個大陰謀。為了尋找真相,三個人齊心協力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Magic Blade Sects disciple Ya Qing gets implicated in a snakeman trouble and meets two girls during her escape from a killer. The three girls are told by a master about the conspiracy behind the snakeman. To uncover the truth, they team up to defeat the mastermind of the conspiracy and unveil the grudges in the elder generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個佛與魔較量的故事。為阻止上古妖魔羅剎降世,將世間顛覆成萬劫不復的寒冰煉獄,少林寺弟子慧海踏上了尋找降龍羅漢之旅。青梅竹馬的上官靈素始終陪伴守護慧海,不畏困難,幫助慧海破除心魔,參透少林精神,最終憑..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a battle between Buddha and Devil, Shaolin disciple Hui Hai embarks on a journey to find Luo Han to stop the demon from turning the world upside down. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青雲堂的女掌門於勝男為了完成病重父親的願望,急於結婚。她在相親時認識了牛多多,而牛在威逼利誘下簽了假結婚協議。正當勝男漸漸被牛的善良和純真吸引,多年前被勝男父親逐出師門的師兄林傑歸來,並用牛威脅勝男接..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yu Sheng Nan rushes to get married to fulfil her dying fathers wish and forces Niu, a man she just knew, to sign a bogus marriage agreement. As Yu gradually falls for Niu, her expelled senior returns and forces Yu to accept his duel challenge by threatening her with Nius safety. A deadly martial arts fight has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青雲堂的女掌門於勝男為了完成病重父親的願望,急於結婚。她在相親時認識了牛多多,而牛在威逼利誘下簽了假結婚協議。正當勝男漸漸被牛的善良和純真吸引,多年前被勝男父親逐出師門的師兄林傑歸來,並用牛威脅勝男接..

As Yu gradually falls for Niu, her expelled senior returns and forces Yu to accept his duel challenge by threatening her with Nius safety. A deadly martial arts fight has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漁民子豪生活在海邊小鎮歸港,以捕魚為生。有一天,他偶然遇到一位神秘的女孩小藝,兩人互生情愫,終於走在一起。但好景不長,突然有一個名叫老金的神秘中年人到來,揭開了小藝真實的身份竟然是人魚族!子豪能否接受..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love.  However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day.  Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀七十年代,香港在英國殖民統治下貪腐嚴重,黑惡勢力橫行,毒梟坤哥及豪哥大賺不義之財。廉政公署人員白玫瑰奉命潛伏到黑幫大佬豪哥身邊收集罪證。玫瑰與豪哥日漸熟識,兩人互生情愫。面對一面是將毒梟繩之以法..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Drug lords Kun and Hao prosper amidst a corrupt landscape in the 1970s Hong Kong. ICAC officer Rose embarks on a mission to infiltrate Haos gang to gather evidence. However, as Rose and Hao fall in love, she faces a heart-wrenching dilemma — choosing between her duty to bring him down and the irresistible pull of their intensifying romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 錦毛鼠白玉堂因不滿展昭被賜禦貓封號,同結拜兄弟“陷空島五鼠在東京火神節上盜取火神像,以此羞辱負責巡防治安的展昭。不料二人在爭搶火神像時,祭祀大典和整個煙花坊突起水澆不滅的大火,無辜百姓被燒成灰燼。白..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Upset by Constable Zhangs prestigious title of Imperial Cat, Bai and his sworn brother steal a god statue during the Tokyo God of Fire Festival to embarass Zhang. Tragedy strikes as a fire breaks out, claiming innocent lives. Bai and Zhang join forces to investigate the truth behind the incident and vow to take down the real culprit.

epg.programme_title_en: The Thousand Faces of Fei Jia
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王小俠本是一個胸無大志,在市井街頭討生活的小鎮青年,與父親老瞎子生活在十隱鎮,唯一的願望就是能治好父親的眼疾。一次偶然令王小俠邂逅了沈藍兒,並意外地捲入了一場陰謀之中。而王小俠為了找能治好父親的眼疾方..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young man Wang Xiao Xia resides in a small town with his blind father. His only desire is to cure his fathers eye disease. One day, he encounters Shen Nan Er by chance and gets embroiled in a conspiracy. In his quest to heal his fathers eyes, he goes to the Qi Yin Sect and finally unveils his hidden identity, which was concealed by his father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太平洋的某處孤島上建立了一座沒有法律限製的「無罪之城」,眾多犯罪分子慕名前往,以求庇護。國際特種兵唐柯在無罪之城執行任務時不幸落入索蘭的圈套,逃生時發現自己體內被注射毒劑,生命只剩下幾小時。面對妻子被..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Innocent City is built on an isolated island with no laws set in place and many criminals go there for shelter. Tang, of the special forces, is trapped by Solan during his mission, and though he escapes, he is poisoned and has few hours to live. As Solan also kills Tang’s wife and kidnaps his daughter, Tang embarks on a road to revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 初任上海警察隊長的陳虎接到一樁命案,軍政部部長之子何滿君離奇死亡。何是聖馬丁高中的一名學生,為了獲得破案信息,陳喬裝學生混入學校。他一邊查案,一邊與各方勢力展開較量,而何之死迷霧重重,一個又一個嫌疑人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The son of a minister is mysteriously killed. The newly appointed police inspector Chen Fu, goes undercover as a secondary student to investigate the case. As he carries on investigation in the school, Chen encounters different potential suspects, making the case more mysterious. What is the cause of the murder and who is the killer?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以阿古力為首的狼衛軍攻打硫勒城,企圖得到竊天氏的龍脈寶藏和天下第一美人將軍史天驕。守城將軍史萬夫寡不敵眾,與好友肖不平密謀,利用《竊天書》設計反攻狼衛軍。史為了擊退狼衛軍,拯救自己的女兒和全城百姓,竟..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wolf Guard Army invades the city to seize the treasure of Qie Tian Clan and to capture a beautiful female general. Though largely outnumbered, General Shi and his friend Shao plot to counterattack the Wolf Guard Army. To rescue his daughter and the people, Shi decapitates himself continues to battle the enemies as a headless general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海上救難隊員阿傑為了生計及克服之前同伴遇難的陰影,再次乘坐漁船出海謀生,卻再次遭遇巨大的危機。在船上的人不僅要面對惡劣的暴雨天氣,還有海底未知生物正對著他們虎視眈眈。在茫茫大海中,猙獰相對的眾人更必須..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navy officer Ah Jie returns to the fleet to earn a living and tries to recover from the trauma of his comrades death. The fleet encounters severe rainstorm and has to face an unknown sea creature. In the face of adversity, everyone on board must overcome the challenges to trust and support each other in order to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商朝末年,紂王暴虐殘害百姓。與此同時,通天教的仙人們接二連三地因為出手阻撓薑子牙帶領的周軍而喪命。通天教主因此動怒,憤然與申公豹聯手,利用萬仙殺陣企圖一舉清除周軍。薑子牙也結集楊戩、哪吒等眾仙一起對抗..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Shang dynasty, the deities of Tong Tian Cult are killed by the Zhou army led by Jiang Zi Ya. Fueled by anger, the Cult leader unites with Shen Gong Pao to exterminate the Zhou army by setting up a thousand deities trap. Meanwhile, Jiang Zi Ya join forces with Yang Jian, Na Zha and other deities to fight the evil forces and rescue mankind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊防部隊正在追蹤國內最大毒梟組織旭東商會的一批價值數百萬美元的毒品,卻被劉老三團夥搶走。警方找到在監獄服刑劉的兄弟大飛,說服他幫忙找回毒品。組織老大黃旭東知道貨被搶,便找了國際僱傭軍準備捉人搶貨。邊防..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Recruited from prison for an undercover mission, convict Da Fei returns to the criminal underworld to investigate his former sworn brother, who stole a cartel drug shipment. However, when ruthless mercenaries kidnap his mother, Da Fei joins forces with border police in a desperate battle for justice and redemption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年後的未來世界,一群食客打算去一家違法經營的野味飯店享受一頓野味大餐,突然當中有一隻變種巨蜥衝破了鐵籠逃走,之後店員一個接一個地神秘失蹤。在此同時捕鼠專家阿發接到飯店的滅鼠委託,本來的滅鼠行動卻變..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2040s, a group of customers visits an illegal restaurant serving wild animal meat. Suddenly, a giant lizard mutant escapes from the cage and the restaurant staff disappears one by one. Meanwhile, a rat catcher is tasked by the restaurant to exterminate rats, but it turns out to be a terrifying battle against the lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥,人族首領黃帝得奇門遁甲的力量終於平定世界,之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭周同因為被死對頭追殺,逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了周同,及後在霧..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋末年,國家陷入內憂外患的局面。狄族聯合魔教,妄想踏平中原稱霸江湖,危難之際,無極派大弟子張君寶又名張三豐挺身而出,協助朝廷擊退敵軍,卻不料師門慘遭魔教血洗,死傷慘重。為了振興門派,保衛家園,張毅然..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tribe Di join forces with the Demon Cult to rule the martial arts world. Zhang San Feng, a disciple of Wu Ji Clan, helps the government to fight the rebels but this results in his clan suffering heavy casualties. To save his clan and his homeland, Zhang sets out to destroy the Demon Cult but gets entangled in another conspiracy in the process.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1996年之前的香港,雪麗在自己的婚禮現場遭遇劫匪挾持,並目睹丈夫死於匪徒槍下。雪現於一家射箭館任職,在颱風之夜意外滯留大樓內,並目擊當年同一幫匪徒在大廈內殺人。在逃亡過程中,她遇到了同為滯留者的盲眼..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During her wedding in 1996, Xue Li is taken hostage by gangsters and saw her husband being killed. One night in a typhoon, Xue Li is forced to stay at her workplace in a building, where she witnesses another murder by the same group of gangsters. As she tries to escape, she meets a blind old man and they must fight for survival together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊境小鎮妖魔遺禍,吳靖子發出請柬,請各位降妖高手前來支援。市井遊民阿拾,意外被孟珠救下後竟愛上孟珠,要拜她為師,一路跟著孟珠及其他降妖高手前往小鎮去消滅在雲棧洞內的千年豬妖。最後阿拾以自己的性命為代價..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Jing Zi seeks help from demon hunters to cast away the evil spirits in town. Saved by demon hunter Meng Zhu, Ah Shi falls in love with her and becomes her disciple. They journey to Yu Zhan Cave to kill the Pig Demon with other hunters. In the end, Ah Shi sacrifices himself to let the hunters fight their way out, but the result is unexpected...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來的地球資源匱乏,各國頂尖科學家將數種動植物的物種送往火星培養,希望改善火星的環境能夠適合人類居住。然而生物在實驗中開始發生變異攻擊人類,身在火星的專家們情況十分危險。中國派出太空人進行救援,他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有妖怪殺手之稱的劉一刀為了給妹妹治病,不惜退隱江湖四處尋訪名醫。此時以蛇女和金蟾子為首的妖族,正密謀危害人間。後來劉陰差陽錯遇到錦鯉精小巒,得知她是黑龍轉世。妖族亦知道此事,也想爭奪小巒帶她去召喚..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon killer Liu Yi Dao retires from the martial arts world to find a doctor for his ailing sister. Meanwhile, the demon clan is plotting against the human world. Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有妖怪殺手之稱的劉一刀為了給妹妹治病,不惜退隱江湖四處尋訪名醫。此時以蛇女和金蟾子為首的妖族,正密謀危害人間。後來劉陰差陽錯遇到錦鯉精小巒,得知她是黑龍轉世。妖族亦知道此事,也想爭奪小巒帶她去召喚..

Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,日本特務吉岡意圖找到龍棺裡的徐福寶藏,便命人僱傭探險家陳啟龍尋找一本神秘的竹簡。陳在一座古墓中找到竹簡,及後得知是交給日本人,便搶回竹簡和傭金。根據竹簡上的指引,陳與夥伴們踏上蓬萊仙島尋找寶..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Japanese agent commissions Chinese explorer Chen to locate a bamboo note leading to Xu Fu’s treasure. Chen finds the note but refuses to give it to the Japanese, keeping both the note and his pay. As Chen and his friends follow the instructions to an island where the treasure is concealed, they are unaware that a mysterious pursuit is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期上海,怪物獵人宇文預測到上豪大飯店有怪獸出現,而當怪獸現身襲擊表演的花旦顧青時,宇文英雄救美,打斷富少警探天明的公開表白。之後三人被捲入了一系列的奇怪案件,在調查過程中,所有線索都指向一個塵封..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican time in Shanghai, monster hunter Yu saves an actress in a play from a monsters attack, at the same time interrupting a cops love confession for her. As the trio gets involved in a series of mysterious cases, they find out that the cases are related to a legend about a giant monster who will soon be returning to the world...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成,包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事;《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會,卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事;《官能許願》超能力男孩,以器官為代價,拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事;及..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓渺是八仙之一韓湘子的化身,在一個缺水猶如沙漠的世界一路向東歷練。而正在執掌東海的龍女因失去記憶,化成了一條魚精,意外遇到和自己有宿世因緣的韓渺。二人走在一起,在東遊途中受到高人指點去尋找 “龍門 ..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Han Miao is one of the eight immortals living in a desert. Dragon Maiden, who helms the East Ocean, loses her memory and becomes a fish demon. When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. With help from a guru, they set out for Dragon Gate where Dragon Maiden can resume her identity and locate the water source.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金傲為保護中華傲決與無敵大戰,在生命垂危的時候將中華傲決傳授給華英雄。然而擁有“天煞孤星命格的華英雄失去了父母及妻子,離開了兒女,潛心修煉二十年卻始終無法參悟中華傲決。最終,華為了所有中國人要與無敵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jin Ao battles with Wu Di to preserve the Pride martial arts skill, which he passes to Hero Hua before he dies. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. Can Hua finally master the skill and defeats Wu Di to save his people?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 長安大理寺捕快郝龍霄神功蓋世,卻為救被妖獸傷害的妹妹,被幻獸妖魔之王鬼車所利用,得奪取各樣法器來助鬼車開啟陣法。原來鬼車的目的是吸聚百姓精血,顛覆人類,以幻獸來控制世界。幸而郝識破鬼車的陰謀,在危急關..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his sister, top martial artist Constable Xie is forced by the Monster King to find all magical weapons for a tactical plot. The Monster Kings real purpose is to suck peoples blood and control the world through eudemon. Knowing his evil plan, Constable Xie decides to unlock his hidden power and begins a fierce battle with Monster King.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江南才子唐伯虎在宴會中為心儀女子桃寶一擲千金,卻被神秘男子出重金羞辱。唐氣憤出手打人,不料那人正是皇上,因此他被通緝。為了躲避追捕,唐偽裝成太監潛入宮中,卻陰差陽錯被卷入閩南王馮達的造反事件。唐得知造..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang Bo Hu spends lavishly on a woman but is outbid by a mysterious man. Angered, Tang punches the man, who is actually the Emperor. He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. As Tang discovers that the evidence of Fengs rebellion is hidden in a painting, he vows to uncover the plot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛建成的洛陽宮夜裡被一條神龍縱火焚燒,木匠不是死就是失蹤。狄仁傑破格升任大理寺少卿查案,卻遭神秘勢力阻撓。他憑線索及隱士李先生的指點找到了關鍵人物宮少爺,也在紅顏知己柳月如協助下摧毀了機關基地。關鍵時..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The newly completed Luo Yang Palace is set to fire by the Fire Dragon, resulting in the carpenters being missing or dead. Detective Dee is tasked to investigate the case. He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蘅王統治下民不聊生,有志之士誓要推翻蘅王,立下衣帶詔。蘅王請魏侯爺找出衣帶詔,並要派殺手殺死名單上所有人。白山水和謝柔均在名單上,而謝柔的弟弟謝長勝對白心生愛慕,與其他殺手一路追蹤白到客棧。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the oppressive rule of Emperor Heng, some volunteers sign on the Belt Oath to overthrow the government. The Emperor sends killers to eliminate them, including Bai Shan Sui and Xie Rou. Xies brother falls for Bai, so he follows the killers to the inn, but ends up causing a series of hilarious events due to misunderstandings.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大清年間,偏遠的臨江縣有兩名縣令接連被大蟒蛇咬死,百姓人心惶惶。侍衛蘇乞兒和鐵橋三奉命前往臨江縣調查此案。兩人發現當地毒品極樂丸極為盛行,而在調查當中鐵橋三與蘇乞兒也因極樂丸陷入困境。在逆境面前他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在罪惡橫行的世界裡,有一個叫太平鎮的桃花源。這裡有私人英雄守護而未被黑幫入侵。吳正義為了成為私人英雄的一員,每天苦練功夫,在正義救星中心雄先生的幫助下成為私人英雄。隨後他發現該鎮被邪惡集團控制,最終與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蒲松齡在寫故事時無意打開了生老病三道門的封印,放出了巨樹之妖黑山的分身。天女發現黑山,與其大打出手,不幸身形被滅,要借助蒲的妻子甄娘化為人形。打鬥中她們被黑山所困,天女告知蒲若要救出甄娘,他得要感動三..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pu Song Ling accidentally releases the Black Mountain Demon during his writing. A goddess fights the demon but her body is destroyed, leaving behind her spirit. She borrows the body of Pus wife to continue the fight but they get trapped by the Black Mountain Demon. To save his wife, Pu must touch another three demons heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十年前,身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假,不料突發遇到颱風,張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質,妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭,不料又一場颱風來襲,妻子被颱風所困,女兒又被人綁架。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 10 years ago, rescue team leader Zhang suffered the loss of his son in a landslide during a typhoon. His anguish leads to his wifes request for divorce. While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 利欲熏心的地產商為了開發蛇王島,重金收買以金老四為首的黑市捕蛇團夥,企圖登島滅蛇。與此同時,身為養蛇家族後人的陳崢與動物保護專家周曉曉及馬奮,為了印證泰坦巨蟒存在的傳說,亦到島上搜集資料。陳崢等人為了..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A greedy property developer bribes a snake catcher gang to eradicate serpents on King Serpent Island for profit. Meanwhile, the snake clans descendant and two animal protection experts venture to the island to confirm the existence of the legendary Titan Snake, resulting in a fierce battle with the ruthless gang to preserve the islands ecology.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀70年代的舊香港,處於英國殖民統治下的黑暗時代,警方與黑社會勾結,窮人深受其害。在貧民區的“鐵記飯店老闆娘鐵姐,帶領手下員工對抗惡勢力,保護被欺壓的老百姓。他們聯合正義的公民合力打擊黑幫,並與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the 1970s, Hong Kong was in a dark age under British colonization. The police collude with the triads and make the poor suffer. A restauranteur leads her staff to fight against the triads and protect the weak. They team up with the residents to combat the triads and fight against the corrupted police, finally restoring peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世代盤踞東北的神秘張家後人張啟山,身負國仇家恨初到長沙,與身懷絕技的少班主二月紅相遇。兩位少年英雄惺惺相惜,攜手力撼軍閥勢力,共同對抗盤踞長沙無惡不作的軍閥左謙之,還揭開傳聞的“怪物真相,一同守護長..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the mysterious descendant of the Zhang family, Zhang Qi Shan, encounters the martial arts expert Er Yue Hong in Changsha, the two young heroes become acquainted and team up to confront the ruthless warlord Zuo Qian Zhi. They also uncover the truth behind the rumoured monster, and protect the safety of the people of Changsha together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 神州名將李追風在北坡城被薩滿十萬大軍包圍。為了救出李和一眾將士,黃自在將軍組織了八百人隊伍前往營救,在經過重重險阻後終於救出李將軍,並且為了拖延薩滿士兵而甘願留下來鎮守北坡城,等待李將軍帶援軍趕來。最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Huang leads 800 warriors to rescue General Li and other generals trapped by the 100,000 Sha Men troops in Bai Po City. He successfully saved General Li after overcoming various dangers, and stalled Sha Men forces as they await troop reinforcements.  In the end, General Li and the 800 warriors heroically safeguard their homeland.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退出江湖的特工華叔,在老街以開古董店為生。一天,老街遭當地青龍幫強拆時,華叔隱藏的身份被暴露,並受到阿傑為首的神秘組織追殺,由此展開了一場雙雄對決!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學家顏欣培育出超級橡膠種子,赴毒販橫行的極端之地試種。國際安保隊長林翔奉命率隊保護前妻及其科研團隊,眾人剛抵達便遭跨國毒梟圍剿。林翔帶領生死弟兄,在吞噬人命的法外之地與多方勢力周旋,誓與敵人玉石俱焚..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scientist Yan Xin develops super rubber seeds and travels to a remote, lawless, drug-ridden region to cultivate them. Security captain Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife and her crew, but they are besieged by a cartel on arrival. Lin Xiang and his men navigate hostile forces, vowing to take their enemies down with them.

epg.programme_title_tc: Live and Die in East LA
epg.programme_title_en: Live and Die in East LA
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 急診醫生Attila救治一名車禍男童後,意外捲入洛杉磯東區的黑道糾紛。男童竟是黑幫頭目的兒子,而車禍則是預謀的幫派復仇。為救涉案的妹妹免於牢獄之災,Attila被迫成為黑幫的運毒棋子,由此引發一場血腥..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After treating a boy injured in a hit-and-run, ER doctor Attila is drawn into East L.A.’s underworld conflict. The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. To save his sister from prison, Attila becomes a drug courier, igniting a gang war that forces a tragic choice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警校生阿山奉命臥底監獄,接近犯罪集團二把手阿天,暗中搜集其犯罪證據。阿天出獄後,阿山協助他以鐵血手段一路廝殺,最終登上社團話事人之位。然而,阿山頻繁與警方接觸的行跡逐漸敗露,臥底身份被社團識破,瞬間陷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Undercover police officer Shan is sent to prison to befriend crime boss Tin and gather evidence. After Tin’s release, Shan helps him rise through the ranks by eliminating rivals. But when his contact with police arouses suspicion, Shan’s cover is exposed, leaving him in a deadly predicament as a secret that could change everything emerges.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工阿文被安排潛伏於東南亞的軍火商旗下,尋找其手中的一批軍火炸藥並將其銷毀。當他終於找到該批軍火後,卻遭到不明匪徒襲擊。為防止災難發生,阿文決定與他的特工搭檔阿瓊合力奪回軍火。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two homicide detectives investigate a series of grisly murders deep in the forest, where disturbing evidence points to the legendary “Beast”. As the body count rises, they uncover a chilling link between the killings and an ancient local legend, while a terrifying truth hidden deep within the woods slowly comes to light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒精英陳泰樺、老米、阿峰與阿棠奉命秘密緝捕跨國毒梟,卻因隊內黑警洩密,行動甫展開便落入圈套。阿峰當場殉職,隊長盧Sir壯烈犧牲,阿棠則神秘失蹤,兄弟情誼自此崩離。多年後,倖存的陳泰樺與老米誓要查明真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a corrupt cop leaks their operation, four elite narcotics officers are ambushed while pursuing a cross-border drug lord. One is killed, their leader dies in the line of duty, and another vanishes without a trace. Years later, the surviving Chan Tai Wah and Low Mai reunite to expose the long-hidden mole and avenge their fallen comrades.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cult leader Yu Luo Sha slays four sect leaders. Zhuo Yi Hang confronts her but falls in love. When he marries another, her hair turns white, and she vows eternal vengeance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女警梅根與幾名好友到叢林露營度假,卻意外撞破當地腐敗警長非法處決毒販的血腥黑幕。驚覺罪行敗露的警長隨即懸賞萬元,聯合民兵封鎖整座大山展開血腥圍獵。身陷叢林深處、走投無路的梅根唯有帶領同伴深入虎穴,迎戰..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While camping in the woods with friends, police officer Megan witnesses a corrupt sheriff executing drug dealers in cold blood. When the sheriff puts a bounty on her head and mobilizes local militia to hunt her down, Megan and her companions must fight through the wilderness and risk everything to escape alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the tragic loss of his lover, Neua learns Monkey Muay Thai and vows to avenge her death. His lover’s sister, who practises Chinese Kung Fu, initially suspects Neua of being responsible, but later discovers that her sister was killed by an organised crime ring. Together, they join forces to uphold justice and seek vengeance.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法蘭克與女友到中東旅行時,女友慘遭殺害,他更被誣陷為兇手入獄。在死牢中結識一名獄友,並在對方暗中協助下策劃越獄,誓要揭開真相,將真正的兇手繩之以法。然而,唯一的盟友卻在行動前夕離奇身亡,法蘭克唯有孤注..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Frank is framed for murder after his girlfriend is killed during a tragic trip to the Middle East. Imprisoned for a crime he did not commit, he befriends a fellow inmate who helps him plot a daring escape to prove his innocence. However, when his only ally suddenly dies, Frank must risk everything to escape and uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

However, his closest friend, Ray, is a federal agent devoted to justice, forcing them onto opposing sides of the law and leaving them torn between conviction and brotherhood.

As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

When the sheriff puts a bounty on her head and mobilizes local militia to hunt her down, Megan and her companions must fight through the wilderness and risk everything to escape alive.

Grief-stricken, Jas sets deadly traps in the storm-soaked forest and embarks on a bloody quest for revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - The big journey
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mercedes-AMG E63 S is a wolf in sheep's clothing. This station wagon has more power than the Nissan GTR 'Godzilla'. Also: the Porsche Panamera GTS feels at home on the motorway and on the race track. And: Audi's powerful all-purpose executive car RS6.

epg.programme_title_tc: Perfect Ride - Big City - Small Car
epg.programme_title_en: Perfect Ride - Big City - Small Car
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Big City - Small Car
epg.episode_synopsis_en: City cars are on top of the registration statistics. After eight years Opel introduced their Corsa E model. We took a look at this updated classic and two of its competitors, the Japanese fun car Toyota Aygo and the third-generation Smart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Volvo
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The classic car models by Volvo are sometimes square and angular, sometimes rounded and smooth. They are reliable, resilient and comfortable, with a unique style and feel. Almost every Volvo model was an instant classic.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Land Rover
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Robust, honest, simple, the Land Rover is the bedrock of all off-road vehicles. Built in 1948 as a simple car for British farmers, the vehicle quickly became an export hit. Today, the Land Rover is at home all over the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Motorheads - Prince Leopold of Bavaria
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Coming from a famous noble family, Prince Leopold of Bavaria started a career as a rally driver in the 1960s before switching to touring cars. He successfully took part in several international races for the Porsche and BMW brands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Motorheads - Henry Ford
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the early 20th century, automotive pioneer Henry Ford revolutionized the world of car manufacturing with the foundation of the Ford Motor Company and his introduction of the assembly line technique in his factory and the iconic Model T.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - Bentley Continental GT
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The new Bentley Continental GT is the success model of the British luxury brand. Nevertheless, the British have been making losses in recent years. The latest model had to be a success to bring Bentley back to its old strength.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - Kia
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kia is considered to be a Korean brand. But today, the company is a global player and produces the Ceed model family exclusively for and in Europe. We follow the design process in Frankfurt and production in Slovakia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Bella Italia
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, our reporter Verena steers a Piaggio Ape through the streets of Verona, race driver Patrick Simon tries to master the Lamborghini Gallardo and we explore some rules of Italian traffic law when it comes to drinking and driving.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Drivers Dreams
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Competing in a go-kart or driving off-road in a buggy, a Hummer, a 4x4 or a real tank, the Fursten Forest near Fürstenau offers all that on a former army training ground. Also: at tuning fairs car enthusiasts are able to find what their hearts desire.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - BMW motorcycle production
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sheer Driving Pleasure: That’s how BMW advertises not only its cars, but its motorcycles as well. For more than 40 years, these 2-wheelers have stood for maximum comfort, quality, and safety.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Made In - BMW sustainability
epg.episode_synopsis_en: By putting a lot of thought into their production process BMW drastically reduce their amount of waste. Production in the the Rolls-Royce facility in Goodwood, which also belongs to BMW, is based on the same principles of sustainability and efficiency.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Pulse Rising Cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With the Pulsar, Nissan returned to the European compact class market with a serious contender to the Volkswagen Golf. In addition: the American V8 dream sports car, the Chevrolet Corvette C7. And: Subaru's fifth-generation rally icon, the WRX STI.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Fire!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It's getting hot in this episode of Stunt Heroes. Stuntman Paul will be engulfed by flames as everything around him blows up in this dangerous fire stunt. The Action Concept team carefully prepares for this heated scene.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Vive la différence: the cars of Renault are always unusual in design, exceptional in their driving comfort and often avant-gardistic. Renault writes history with the Dauphine, R4, R5 and R16 models.

epg.programme_title_tc: Car History - Citroën - France's iconic cars
epg.programme_title_en: Car History - Citroën - France's iconic cars
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Citroën - France's iconic cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the very beginning, Citroën celebrated the joy of extravagance. Already the Traction Avant from the 1950s is a milestone in automotive history and the 2CV is one of the most unusual and charming small cars ever built.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Spotted - Italy Special
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Italy special: we explain the Ferrari myth and tell the story of the cult cars Fiat 500, Alfa Spider or the Ferrari of TV detective Magnum. Sebastian Vettel also tests the LaFerrari Aperta.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Spotted - Fascination Drag Racing
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Drag racing is extreme motorsport with addictive potential. Not quite as brute, but at least as fascinating: V8 sports cars. The Aston Martin DB11 is the first to use a V8 engine.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Motorheads - Walter Röhrl
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One cannot talk about rally sports without mentioning the name Walter Röhrl. From an early age, Röhrl showed his talent in rally sports and won the European, World and other international rally championships several times in his career.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Motorheads - Hans-Joachim Stuck
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hans-Joachim Stuck is one of the best racing drivers in Germany. Over his long career he not only won the Formula II and several international touring car championships multiple times but also the famous 24-hour race of Le Mans twice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Turbo Diesel Power
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We took a look at Audi's latest generation of TDI engines and their RS5 TDI Concept. In addition we compared the advantages and disadvantages of the two main fossil fuels for cars, gasoline and diesel. And: the 2014 Porsche Cayenne Diesel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Lightweight Cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The BMW i8 was one of the first sports cars with some sort of a green image. In addition we took two fly-weight sports cars, the Lotus Elise and the Roding Roadster, to one of the most beautiful alpine pass roads.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - Bodyfights
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For a showreel, the team choreographs a fight that involves hand-to-hand combat, glass bottles shattering on heads and bodies crashing through walls. In the end, a car flies high, detonates in the air, leaving a trail of destruction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The Flying Quad
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Action Concept wreck more than 100 cars each year for their stunts. In this episode, a quad rider is chased by a car. The car is crashed in the process and the quad bike also has to be destroyed, but the question is how?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - The BMW Story
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The emphatically sporty cars and motorbikes of BMW are equally successful with customers and in racing. However, the former aircraft engine manufacturer's entry into automobile production threatened to fail at an early stage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Porsche 550 Spyder
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Porsche 550 Spyder is small and fast, but only 140 units were built. It was Porsche's first racing sports car and laid the foundation for the German manufacturer to be considered a force in car racing today.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Wild through the desert
epg.episode_synopsis_en: BMW and the German racing team X-Raid take part in the Dakar Rally with a transformed Mini Countryman. Also: the Mercedes G63 AMG 6x6, a 6-wheel off-road monster. And: the Kia Sportage feels both at home in the rocky terrain of Sicily and the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Trendy City-SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: City-SUVs are the latest trend in the automotive world. The Subaru XV shows its offroad skills, and the Nissan Juke is taken to the race track in Dubai. And: the Mercedes-AMG and the Audi RS Q3 GLA face each other in the mountains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Motorheads - Stéphane Peterhansel
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winning the iconic Dakar Rally for a record 13 times, Frenchman Stéphane Peterhansel had a rather unusual career as he switched from motorbikes to cars and was enormously successful with both vehicles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Motorheads - Alois Ruf
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Alois Ruf is the founder of a small, but well-known car manufacturing company in Bavaria that specialises in building their own vision of street legal super sports cars on the foundation of Porsche bodys.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Open-top two-seater sports cars, super sports cabriolets by Ferrari, Lamborghini, Porsche, Bentley and McLaren, are built for velocities exceeding 300 km/h and unparalleled driving pleasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Lifestyle Cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over the decades compact and city cars have become more and more popular, especially in urban areas. We took a look at three examples for these modern lifestyle vehicles, the 5-door Mini, the Opel Adam Rocks and the Kia Soul EV.

epg.programme_title_tc: Perfect Ride - King of the ring
epg.programme_title_en: Perfect Ride - King of the ring
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - King of the ring
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Nürburgring Nordschleife is known as the toughest speedway in the world. Together with race driver Hans-Joachim Stuck we take a look at the history of this iconic race track as well as the events and record attempts that have been taking place there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - International Supercars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The super sports cars by Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Pagani and Porsche are like Formula One racing cars for the streets, the fastest and most exciting cars in the world, whose power and performance seem to defy the laws of physics.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - US SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: US SUVs and pickup trucks like the Cadillac Escalade, Chevrolet Tahoe, Ford Raptor or Dodge Ram are large, powerful and luxurious and exude the feeling of unlimited possibilities and adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - American Beauties
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Beauties like the Corvette, Mustang, Camaro or Shelby Cobra represent the American dream of freedom. These spectacular cars with their massive bonnets, lush chrome décor and large tail fins excite enthusisasts since the 1950s.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - Power Limousines
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Power limousines like the BMW M5, Mercedes-AMG E63, Audi RS6 and Mulsanne Speed offer a unique mix of style, performance and suitability for daily use. They combine the luxury of a limousine with the dynamics of a super sports car.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Land Rover Special
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Land Rover Defender is one of the oldest offroad car models. We took a look at this iconic vehicle and 70 years of Land Rover history. Also: we took the Range Rover Evoque, the most recent model of the British brand, to the legendary Silk Road.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - Extraordinary SUVs
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mitsubishi Outlander Plug-In Hybrid, the world's first hybrid SUV with two electric motors and a 2-liter combustion engine. Also: the Chevrolet Silverado, an American full-size pickup with a V8 and an average consumption of at least 15 liters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Ready for Action
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Behind the scenes of some of the exciting stunts at Action Concept, the biggest action movie production company in Europe. Also: Johannes and Ferdinand Stuck with the BMW Alpina D5 Twin Turbo at the test track. And: the Volkswagen Up city car.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Out Of Space
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We visited the inventor of the Fahrradi Farfalla FFX that looks like an Italian sports car but is muscle-powered like a bicycle. And: apart from the regular car tuning fare, the Essen Motor Show also offers insight into rather peculiar vehicles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Audi Quattro
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Audi Quattro changed the automotive world. For the first time, the all-wheel drive was not only used in a production vehicle, but also in a rally car. Today it is standard in these areas.

epg.programme_title_tc: FIM X-Trial World Championship 2026 - X-Trial Andorra la Vella
epg.programme_title_en: FIM X-Trial World Championship 2026 - X-Trial Andorra la Vella
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: FIM X-Trial World Championship 2026 - X-Trial Andorra la Vella
epg.episode_synopsis_en: X-Trial 2026 begins in Andorra la Vella, where the world's best indoor trial riders face a demanding season opener. Toni Bou, Gabriel Marcelli and Jaime Busto battle for early championship momentum in a spectacular arena showdown.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On Tour - 125 Years Mercedes
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mercedes-Benz purposefully chose the historic Berlin-Tempelhof airport in order to celebrate the company's 125th anniversary. The celebration with its many show races and classic cars attracted visitors and fans from all over the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On Tour - BMW M1 Meeting
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Each year, thousands of motor racing fans visit the Histo-Cup Austria classic car race at the Salzburgring in order to admire more than 200 historical race cars in action. We witnessed the first presentation of the BMW M1 Procar series since 1979 there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Fast Zone 2026 - Episode 03
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fast Zone follows the Michelin 24H Dubai, with Loek Hartog, Anthony MacIntosh and the GT3 field battling through a full day of endurance racing. The show also previews the new ADAC GT Masters season with drivers preparing for another campaign.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Fast Zone 2026 - Episode 04
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fast Zone previews the 2025 DTM season, featuring champion Mirko Bortolotti, Timo Glock's comeback and teenage rookie Tom Kalender. Ford returns with the Mustang, while new Aston Martin and Ferrari line-ups add even more variety to the grid.

epg.programme_title_tc: Trackmasters - Brighter days at the Nürburgring
epg.programme_title_en: Trackmasters - Brighter days at the Nürburgring
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Trackmasters - Brighter days at the Nürburgring
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the weather cleared up a bit at the Nürburgring, we were finally back at the track. As soon as the snow and ice were gone the horsepower junkies returned to the ring to once again let their engines roar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Trackmasters - Racing legend Olaf Manthey
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The history of Olaf Manthey, a racing legend who has won the 24-hour race four times in a row. Stick around to find out the secret of his success.

epg.programme_title_en: FIM EnduroGP World Championship 2025 - Grand Prix of Spain, Oliana
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: FIM EnduroGP World Championship 2025 - Grand Prix of Spain, Oliana
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Round 2 of the 2025 FIM Enduro GP World Championship, the Grand Prix of Spain, home to some of the best riders in the world, takes place in Oliana.

epg.programme_title_tc: Put your Car on TV - Chevy Camaro vs Mercedes SLS AMG
epg.programme_title_en: Put your Car on TV - Chevy Camaro vs Mercedes SLS AMG
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Put your Car on TV - Chevy Camaro vs Mercedes SLS AMG
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi invite car freaks from the Middle East to show off their souped-up vehicles on the "Walk" at Jumeirah Beach in Dubai. In this episode, a Chevrolet Camaro competes against a Mercedes SLS AMG.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Put your Car on TV - Chevy Camaro vs Mercedes SLS AMG
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi invite car freaks from the Middle East to show off their souped-up vehicles on the "Walk" at Jumeirah Beach in Dubai. In this episode, a Chevrolet Camaro competes against a Mercedes SLS AMG.

epg.programme_title_tc: FIM X-Trial World Championship 2026 - X-Trial Andorra la Vella
epg.programme_title_en: FIM X-Trial World Championship 2026 - X-Trial Andorra la Vella
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: FIM X-Trial World Championship 2026 - X-Trial Andorra la Vella
epg.episode_synopsis_en: X-Trial 2026 begins in Andorra la Vella, where the world's best indoor trial riders face a demanding season opener. Toni Bou, Gabriel Marcelli and Jaime Busto battle for early championship momentum in a spectacular arena showdown.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On Tour - 125 Years Mercedes
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mercedes-Benz purposefully chose the historic Berlin-Tempelhof airport in order to celebrate the company's 125th anniversary. The celebration with its many show races and classic cars attracted visitors and fans from all over the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On Tour - BMW M1 Meeting
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Each year, thousands of motor racing fans visit the Histo-Cup Austria classic car race at the Salzburgring in order to admire more than 200 historical race cars in action. We witnessed the first presentation of the BMW M1 Procar series since 1979 there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Fast Zone 2026 - Episode 03
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fast Zone follows the Michelin 24H Dubai, with Loek Hartog, Anthony MacIntosh and the GT3 field battling through a full day of endurance racing. The show also previews the new ADAC GT Masters season with drivers preparing for another campaign.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Fast Zone 2026 - Episode 04
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fast Zone previews the 2025 DTM season, featuring champion Mirko Bortolotti, Timo Glock's comeback and teenage rookie Tom Kalender. Ford returns with the Mustang, while new Aston Martin and Ferrari line-ups add even more variety to the grid.

epg.programme_title_tc: Trackmasters - Brighter days at the Nürburgring
epg.programme_title_en: Trackmasters - Brighter days at the Nürburgring
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Trackmasters - Brighter days at the Nürburgring
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the weather cleared up a bit at the Nürburgring, we were finally back at the track. As soon as the snow and ice were gone the horsepower junkies returned to the ring to once again let their engines roar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Trackmasters - Racing legend Olaf Manthey
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The history of Olaf Manthey, a racing legend who has won the 24-hour race four times in a row. Stick around to find out the secret of his success.

epg.programme_title_tc: FIM Sidecarcross World Championship 2026 - Poland, Gdansk
epg.programme_title_en: FIM Sidecarcross World Championship 2026 - Poland, Gdansk
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: FIM Sidecarcross World Championship 2026 - Poland, Gdansk
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Round five brings Sidecarcross to Gdansk, Poland. Marvin Vanluchene and Ben van den Bogaart win the opening race, but trouble in race two opens the door for Killian and Evan Prunier to fight back and take the overall Grand Prix victory.

epg.programme_title_tc: Put your Car on TV - Lamborghini Aventador vs GMC Chevrolet
epg.programme_title_en: Put your Car on TV - Lamborghini Aventador vs GMC Chevrolet
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Put your Car on TV - Lamborghini Aventador vs GMC Chevrolet
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The "Walk" at JBR in Dubai is the venue for our competition, as far as fancy and luxurious cars from all over the Middle East are concerned. This time, a Lamborghini Aventador and a GMC Chevrolet are among the participants.

epg.programme_title_tc: Put your Car on TV - Lexus GSF vs McLaren MP4-12C
epg.programme_title_en: Put your Car on TV - Lexus GSF vs McLaren MP4-12C
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Put your Car on TV - Lexus GSF vs McLaren MP4-12C
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The competition for the coolest souped-up cars in the Middle East continues. The prize is an overnight stay for two at the Sofitel Jumeirah Beach. This time, the spotlight is on a Lexus GSF, a Ford Mustang and a McLaren MP4-12C.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Fast Zone 2026 - Episode 05
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fast Zone brings the ADAC GT4 Germany opener from the Red Bull Ring and Ferrari Challenge Europe from Paul Ricard. Benjamin Sylvestersson and Gabriele Piana shine in GT4, while Sergio Paulet, Gilles Renmans and Michael Verhagen battle in France.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Fast Zone 2026 - Episode 06
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fast Zone covers Formula Regional European Championship at Red Bull Ring and Porsche Carrera Cup Deutschland at Imola. Kean Nakamura-Berta and Rashid Al Dhaheri star in Austria, while Theo Oeverhaus and Keegan Masters lead the Porsche action.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Trackmasters - VLN Endurance Championship, Round 1
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Once again it was time for the VLN Endurance Racing Championship. While the drivers were doing their test laps, we had a look behind the scenes and explored what went on in the pit lanes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Trackmasters - VLN Endurance Championship, Round 2
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Nürburgring shook when the VLN began its second leg of the tournament. We once again accompany you to this exciting competition, including the highlights of BMW's 1st leg win.

epg.programme_title_tc: FIM EnduroGP World Championship 2025 - Grand Prix of Sweden, Skövde
epg.programme_title_en: FIM EnduroGP World Championship 2025 - Grand Prix of Sweden, Skövde
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: FIM EnduroGP World Championship 2025 - Grand Prix of Sweden, Skövde
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After sun and rain in the first two events, it’s off to Skövde in cooler Sweden for Round 3 of the 2025 FIM Enduro GP.

epg.programme_title_tc: On Tour - Truck Grand Prix am Nuerburgring
epg.programme_title_en: On Tour - Truck Grand Prix am Nuerburgring
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On Tour - Truck Grand Prix am Nuerburgring
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At the Truck Grand Prix at the Nürburgring in Germany, dozens of high-powered trucks compete in front of hundreds of fans. We present some of the competitors and show you a duel between one of the trucks and a Lamborghini Gallardo.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: For the first time ever, the DTM held a big show event at the Olympiastadion in Munich. We summarise the two-day challenge where we interviewed some of the racers from Audi and Mercedes-Benz, the two featured brands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Typically German
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What are the characteristics of a typical German car? Do stereotypes like functionality, reliability but also a certain dullness paint a realistic picture? Also, we explored if the Volkswagen Golf GTE could bring new impulses to the brand's model range.

epg.programme_title_tc: Perfect Ride - Driving pleasure in winter
epg.programme_title_en: Perfect Ride - Driving pleasure in winter
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Driving pleasure in winter
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Slippery or muddy roads and bad visibility are circumstances that often spoil driving pleasure in winter. We took two almost identical Porsche 911's to an icy test track. Also: drifting fun in the snow with the Suzuki SX4 S-Cross.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Volkswagen Golf
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Volkswagen Golf is nothing more but a reasonable car - there's nothing really exciting about it, but still it's a mega-seller. The Golf is compatible with the masses and dominates the compact car class since its market introduction.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Car History - Porsche Motorsport
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Be it the 24 Hours of Le Mans, the Monte Carlo Rally or Formula 1: Porsche won it all at least once. Even the first prototype was a race winner, and the successes of the Spyder in the Carrera Panamericana or the Targa Florio are unforgettable.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - German Convertibles
epg.episode_synopsis_en: German convertibles like the the Porsche 911 Cabriolet or the Mercedes-AMG Roadster enjoy a worldwide reputation. They stand for perfection and reliability and are considered the embodiment of status and an expression of lifestyle and joy of life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Dreamcars - Italian Super Sports Cars
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Italian super sports cars like the Ferrari „La Ferrari“, the Lamborghini Aventador or the Pagani Huayra are the most beautiful and fastest cars in the world, created by the best designers. Italian super sports cars are dreams made reality.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - SUV Girlpower
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nancy and Nadia, two daring Jordanian women, took part in the Conti 4x4 Trophy. Also: two of our female editors test the Asian SUVs SsangYong Rexton and Hyundai Grand Santa Fe. Also: the BMW X5 M, a sports car in an SUV outfit?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 4x4 - SUV Concepts
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Bentley EXP 9F and Jaguar C-X17 are concept cars the two manufacturers presented before they started making their own luxury SUVs. Also: how did Toyota, Nissan or Subaru see the future of the SUV? And: Mercedes-Benz' Unimog concept car.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Changing the model
epg.episode_synopsis_en: BMW got into the electric mobility business with their ActiveE and i3 models. We visited the company's technology office in Silicon Valley. Also: the Stuck brothers at the test track with the Mercedes C 63 AMG. And: the Audi A3 Sportback.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Perfect Ride - Essen Motor Show
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Essen Motor Show focuses both on the latest trends in car tuning as well as the usual performance enhancement in quite obvious but also unusual car models. We took a look around this special fare and talked to some of the creative minds.

epg.programme_title_tc: Stunt Heroes - The new stunt convertible
epg.programme_title_en: Stunt Heroes - The new stunt convertible
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Stunt Heroes - The new stunt convertible
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A skidding lorry versus a remote-controlled van. Stunt coordinator Christoph Domanski plan is to separate the roof from the rest of the vehicle. If his idea works, the team will create a unique stunt convertible.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在無間的生死大戰中,動物已經進化出各種各樣的顏色,圖案和形狀,幫助它們捕獵,隱藏和保護自己.我們在本集解釋了一些最有趣的偽裝和變色能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hiding in plain sight helps many insect, fish, and amphibian species survive. Learn the ins and outs of an array of animal invisibility techniques, such as warning and disruptive colouration, mimicry, and active camouflage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 野狗群的世界正在面對一場巨變,他們豐富的狩獵地正受到斑點鬣狗群的威脅.脆弱的狗寶寶已開始挨餓,因為無情的獵食者對手偷走了他們的食物,最終還突擊他們的棲身地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their den.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對獅子來說,水牛固然是令人滿足的晚餐,但同時也是危險的獵物.與穆瓦姆巴獅群一起追蹤為數近三百頭水牛,並從中窺探他們的獵食技巧,他們必須迅速而謹慎地行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To the lion, the buffalo is not only a satisfying dinner but also dangerous. Track a herd of 300 buffalo along with the Mwamba pride, who must act quickly and carefully if they are to take down their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​展開由月球力量引導的史詩般的旅程.看看無形的信號如何指引鯨魚和海龜沿著海洋遷徙路線,與夜鷹鳥一起穿越大陸,並觀察糞甲蟲及其他依靠月光導航的昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #1 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識在喀拉哈里盆地合力確保共存的罕有合作者.瞭解大象族群與結果白相思樹的共生關係,貓鼬與吵鬧卷尾鳥的聯盟,以及更多一對對動物相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the unlikely collaborators working to ensure mutual survival in the Kalahari Basin. Learn of an elephant clans symbiotic link to fruiting anaboom trees, a meerkats alliance with a feisty drongo bird, and more flora-and-fauna odd couples.

epg.programme_title_tc: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喀拉哈里的動物們渴望雨水,因為牠們已經忍受了極端乾旱的一年.見證象群在拼命尋找水源時的合作,邂逅幫助小貓鼬生存的奇怪保姆.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirst for rain alongside the animals of the Kalahari, as they endure a brutally dry year. Witness co-operation between elephant herds in their desperate search for water and meet a meerkats strange babysitter, who helps the next generation survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 散落在不同海洋上的島嶼,其多樣性超乎想像;演化亦在你眼前發生.從加拉帕戈斯群島走到南極洲,看看海獅,雀鳥,蟋蟀,猴子和其他野生動物,如何以驚人的適應力來應對氣候變化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find out why islands are like mini-Earths where evolution happens before your eyes. Journey from the Galápagos to Antarctica to see how sea lions, finches, crickets, monkeys and other wildlife are finding surprising solutions to climatic problems.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿曼達為在馬拉威二十年來出生的首批獵豹幼崽的其中一隻戴上無線電頸圈;團隊努力給一條4米長的蟒蛇一個身體檢查;一群遊客則送來一隻從寵物販賣中救出來的暴躁猴子嬰兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amanda puts a radio collar on one of the first cheetah cubs born in Malawi in twenty years and the team struggles to give a 4-meter python a physical. See a group of tourists deliver a rambunctious baby monkey they rescued from the pet trade.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來看看貪吃鬼貝尼如何闖禍,並從當地的雄性領袖彼得魯克得到令其顫抖的教訓.見證曾經是非法寵物的富家孩子斯潘瑟,如何嘗試控制自己的甜食癮,再跟隨布米和格蕾塔進行一次瘋狂的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shudder as food-obsessed Beni gets a dramatic, educational smackdown from the local dominant male, Petruk. See spoiled rich kid Spanser, a former illegal pet, try to tamp down his sweet tooth before roguish Bumi goes on a wild joyride with Greta.
